name: Ab Aeterno
explicitStats: (200-250)% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield
Gain Overencumbrance for 4 seconds when you Dodge Roll
Your speed is Unaffected by Slows while Sprinting
flavourText: His enemy was for endurance forged. His own waned.
description: (15-30)% increased Movement Speed (200-250)% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield Dodge Roll avoids all Hits Gain Overencumbrance for 4 seconds when you Dodge Roll Your speed is Unaffected by Slows while Sprinting

beginner.whatItIs: A pair of high-level boots whose standout line makes your dodge roll avoid every hit, at the cost of leaving you overencumbered for a few seconds afterwards.
beginner.whyItMatters: Turning the roll into a guaranteed escape rewrites how you fight bosses: the question stops being whether you can survive an attack and becomes whether you rolled at the right moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear them once you are confident reading boss telegraphs, around the level sixty-five requirement. If you roll on reflex rather than on a tell, the encumbrance window will kill you more often than the immunity saves you.

name: Adonia's Ego
explicitStats: +3 to Level of all Spell Skills
-10% to all Elemental Resistances per Power Charge
flavourText:
Adonia rose with eyes afire, emanating a ghastly aura, and broke off a carving from the wall of the Throne Room.
"You think me powerless without my wand? Insult me again!"
description: +(100-150) to maximum Mana +3 to Level of all Spell Skills (15-30)% increased Cast Speed -10% to all Elemental Resistances per Power Charge +(-1-1) to Maximum Power Charges

beginner.whatItIs: A wand that hands you three extra levels on every spell and a big pool of mana, then charges you ten percent of all your elemental resistances for each power charge you are holding.
beginner.whyItMatters: Three levels on every spell skill raises the base damage of what you cast rather than adding a percentage, so the wand is a large jump in power, but the resistance drain means your defences shrink exactly when your damage is at its highest.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a caster that either avoids generating power charges or has resistance to spare from elsewhere. Check the maximum power charge roll first, because a negative roll is a hidden buff here.

name: Aerisvane's Wings
flavourText: The strongest souls are forged through struggle and defeat.
description: (50-70)% increased Armour and Evasion (5-10)% increased Attack Speed +(20-30) to Intelligence Decimating Strike

beginner.whatItIs: Mid-level gauntlets that add intelligence and attack speed and grant Decimating Strike, which shaves a slice off an enemy's current life on hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: A percentage cut ignores how much life a monster has, so these gloves scale with the enemy rather than with your gear, and they stay useful long after their raw numbers stop impressing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Best on a slow, heavy-hitting attack build fighting big rare monsters and bosses. On a fast clear build the effect is wasted, because trash dies to your normal hit anyway.

name: Against the Darkness

flavourText:
After the fires, in the depths of the Winter of the World, all life in the Vastiri banded together.
Whether serpent, hyena, human, or golem, hated enemies clasped hand to claw, built refuge, and fought side by side against the Abyssals.
Thus, the Third Pact was born.
description: (2 random radius jewel modifiers)

beginner.whatItIs: A Time-Lost jewel that rolls two random modifiers and applies them to a small area of the passive tree around the socket you place it in.
beginner.whyItMatters: The pool it rolls from is broad, from extra maximum resistances to added elemental damage, so two of these jewels are almost never the same item and the value depends entirely on the roll you get.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it when the roll you own happens to match what your build already wants, not because the item is unique. Read both modifiers before committing a jewel socket to it.

name: Alkem Eira
explicitStats: Damage Blocked is Recouped as Mana
flavourText: May your resolve never waver.
description: (15-20)% increased Block chance (30-50)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(50-70) to maximum Mana Damage Blocked is Recouped as Mana

beginner.whatItIs: An early crest shield that raises your chance to block and turns the damage you block into mana instead of nothing.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking normally just prevents damage. Recouping it as mana makes every blocked hit pay for your next spell, which quietly solves the mana problem most low-level casters have.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a spellcaster who wants to stand in melee range, especially in the campaign where mana is tight and monsters hit often but not hard.

name: Alpha's Howl
flavourText:
Nature respects the strong
And paints the snow red
With the blood of the weak
description: (80-100)% increased Evasion Rating +100 to Spirit +(50-75)% to Cold Resistance Presence Radius is doubled

beginner.whatItIs: A late helmet that grants a flat hundred spirit, a very large chunk of cold resistance, and doubles the radius of your presence.
beginner.whyItMatters: Spirit is the resource that pays for reserved buffs and minions, so a hundred of it can be a whole extra aura. Doubling presence radius stretches every aura-like effect you own across a much bigger area.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it on a build whose power comes from things that affect nearby allies or enemies. If nothing you run cares about presence, the helmet is just a cold resistance piece.

name: Amor Mandragora
explicitStats: Enemies in your Presence are Hindered
Gain 1 Druidic Prowess for every 20 total Rage spent
flavourText:
A sensitive few among the first settlers of Ezomyr
followed the wisps by canoe. On a misty forested
island, Cirel of Tarth stood waiting to greet them.
description: Adds (16-20) to (23-27) Physical Damage +(8-15) to Intelligence (10-15)% increased Skill Effect Duration Enemies in your Presence are Hindered Gain 1 Druidic Prowess for every 20 total Rage spent

beginner.whatItIs: A talisman that adds physical damage, extends how long your skill effects last, hinders enemies who come near you, and builds Druidic Prowess as you spend rage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It ties two systems together that normally have nothing to do with each other, so a rage-spending build gets a steadily growing druid bonus for doing what it was already doing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only worth it if your build actually spends rage in volume. Twenty rage spent per stack is a lot for a character that generates rage slowly.

name: Andvarius
flavourText: Danger is the price of wealth.
description: (50-70)% increased Rarity of Items found +10 to Dexterity -20% to all Elemental Resistances

beginner.whatItIs: A gold ring that greatly increases how much rare loot you find, and charges twenty percent off all three elemental resistances for it.
beginner.whyItMatters: A twenty percent resistance cut is one of the harshest costs in the game, because resistances are capped and every point below the cap multiplies the damage you take from a whole element.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Swap it in for farming content you already clear comfortably, and swap it out for anything dangerous. Only wear it once the rest of your gear can absorb the loss and still sit at the cap.

name: Apep's Supremacy
explicitStats: 20% of Elemental damage from Hits taken as Chaos damage
100% chance to Poison on Hit with Spell Damage
flavourText: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
description: (100-200)% increased Energy Shield (30-50)% increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate 20% of Elemental damage from Hits taken as Chaos damage +25% chance to be Poisoned 100% chance to Poison on Hit with Spell Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A focus that multiplies your energy shield and its recharge rate, converts a fifth of the elemental damage you take into chaos damage, and poisons enemies with every spell hit while making you far easier to poison.
beginner.whyItMatters: Guaranteed poison on spells is normally impossible, so this focus is the piece that makes a poison caster exist at all, and the chaos conversion is a real defensive trade rather than a footnote.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Build around it, not into it: take it when poison is your main damage source and you have chaos resistance capped. The increased chance to be poisoned is brutal in maps full of poisonous enemies.

name: Apron of Emiran
explicitStats: (60-40)% reduced Duration of Bleeding on You
flavourText:
"Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful with those hooks!"
- The Master Torturer's last words
description: (30-50)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield +(10-20) to Dexterity (60-40)% reduced Duration of Bleeding on You Bleeding you inflict is Aggravated

beginner.whatItIs: A light body armour that shortens bleeding on you and makes every bleed you inflict count as aggravated, meaning it deals its faster moving-target damage even against a standing enemy.
beginner.whyItMatters: Bleeding normally only reaches its full rate when the target is moving, which makes it unreliable on bosses. This armour removes that condition entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it the moment you commit to a bleed build, and keep it until a better aggravation source appears. On any other build the line does nothing at all.

name: Arakaali's Gift
explicitStats: Recover Life equal to (15-20)% of Mana Flask's Recovery Amount when used
Recover Mana equal to (15-20)% of Life Flask's Recovery Amount when used
flavourText:
Devotees of the Goddess of Lust
needed never fear her sting.
description: Recover Life equal to (15-20)% of Mana Flask's Recovery Amount when used Recover Mana equal to (15-20)% of Life Flask's Recovery Amount when used

beginner.whatItIs: An antidote charm that fires when you are poisoned and then cross-heals: your life flask restores some mana and your mana flask restores some life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns one flask press into two kinds of recovery, which matters most for builds that pay life for their skills and cannot afford to run dry on either resource.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it on a character that spends both life and mana, in content where poison is common enough to trigger the charm reliably.

name: Arvil's Wheel
explicitStats: Lose 1% of maximum Life on Kill
Lose 1% of maximum Mana on Kill
flavourText:
The unending carnage of war
mercilessly grinds away
at body and mind.
description: +(40-60) to maximum Life +(40-60) to maximum Mana (60-100)% increased Armour and Evasion Lose 1% of maximum Life on Kill Lose 1% of maximum Mana on Kill (30-50)% increased Skill Effect Duration

beginner.whatItIs: A wooden shield that hands you life, mana, defences and longer-lasting skill effects, then takes one percent of your maximum life and mana every time you kill something.
beginner.whyItMatters: The drain is small per kill and invisible in a boss fight, but in a dense pack it stacks fast, so the shield is far more dangerous while clearing than while fighting one enemy.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Good on a slow single-target build, and on any character with strong regeneration or leech to outpace the loss. Avoid it on a fast clearing build that kills dozens of monsters a second.

name: Ashrend
explicitStats: -10 Physical Damage taken from Attack Hits
flavourText: The blasted oak stands forever.
description: +(40-60) to maximum Life +(10-20) to Strength +(30-40)% to Fire Resistance Cannot be Ignited -10 Physical Damage taken from Attack Hits

beginner.whatItIs: An early coat that gives life, strength and fire resistance, makes you immune to ignite, and flatly subtracts ten physical damage from every attack hit you take.
beginner.whyItMatters: Flat reduction is enormous at low levels, where individual monster hits are often smaller than ten, so this armour can make whole campaign zones stop hurting.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Put it on as soon as you find it and keep it through the campaign. Its value fades in maps, when hits get far larger than the flat reduction.

name: Asphyxia's Wrath
implicitStats: Adds 1 to 3 Physical Damage to Attacks
explicitStats: Adds (3-4) to (5-8) Cold damage to Attacks
Enemies Chilled by your Hits increase damage taken by Chill Magnitude
Attacks Gain (5-10)% of Damage as Extra Cold Damage
flavourText:
Mist of breath
Icing to lips and throat
As the warm ones choke and fall
Upon the frozen wasteland.
description: Adds (3-4) to (5-8) Cold damage to Attacks (5-10)% increased Attack Speed +(5-10)% to Cold Resistance Enemies Chilled by your Hits increase damage taken by Chill Magnitude Attacks Gain (5-10)% of Damage as Extra Cold Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A quiver that adds cold damage to your attacks and makes enemies chilled by your hits take more damage in proportion to how strongly they are chilled.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chill is normally a slow, purely defensive effect. This quiver turns it into an offensive multiplier, so freezing gear starts paying for itself in damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it early on any bow or crossbow build that already deals cold damage. The stronger your chill, the bigger the payoff, so it pairs with cold damage rather than replacing it.

name: Assailum
explicitStats: Skills have a (100-150)% longer Perfect Timing window
flavourText: A moment of calm before the battle can end the war.
description: (200-300)% increased Armour and Evasion +(200-400) to Accuracy Rating (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance Skills have a (100-150)% longer Perfect Timing window

beginner.whatItIs: A helmet with heavy armour and evasion, a big accuracy bonus, and a line that roughly doubles the length of the perfect timing window on your skills.
beginner.whyItMatters: Perfect timing is the reward for releasing a charged attack at the right instant, and hitting it is the difference between a good hit and a great one. Widening the window makes that reward consistent instead of a gamble.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it on any build that holds and releases attacks, especially while you are still learning a weapon's rhythm. It does nothing for instant-cast spell builds.

name: Astramentis
explicitStats: -4 Physical Damage taken from Attack Hits
flavourText:
Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.
description: +(50-100) to all Attributes -4 Physical Damage taken from Attack Hits

beginner.whatItIs: An amulet that grants a very large amount of all three attributes at once and shaves a few physical damage off attack hits taken.
beginner.whyItMatters: Attributes are the hidden tax on gear and gems, and this single item pays that tax for an entire build, freeing dozens of passive points and gear rolls you would otherwise spend on requirements.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Almost always correct on a build that struggles to equip what it wants. It is one of the first uniques worth trading for, and it stays relevant to the end of the game.

name: Atsak's Sight
flavourText:
Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck
only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.
description: (100-150)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield (30-40)% increased Critical Hit Chance +(10-20) to Dexterity +(10-20) to Intelligence Critical Hits Poison the enemy

beginner.whatItIs: A mask that raises evasion, energy shield and critical hit chance, and poisons any enemy you critically hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a critical build a second damage source that scales with chaos and poison rather than with hit damage, without asking you to change a single skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a critical-strike attack build that wants extra damage over time. It is dead weight on a build that rarely crits.

name: Atziri's Acuity
explicitStats: Leech 10% of Physical Attack Damage as Life
10% of Physical damage dealt by your Hits causes Blood Loss
flavourText:
"The heart is the herald.
It will tell me when it is best to strike."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
description: (150-200)% increased Armour +(100-150) to maximum Life Leech 10% of Physical Attack Damage as Life 10% of Physical damage dealt by your Hits causes Blood Loss Vaal Pact

beginner.whatItIs: Heavy gloves that add armour and life, leech a tenth of your physical attack damage back as life, cause blood loss on hits, and grant Vaal Pact.
beginner.whyItMatters: Vaal Pact makes leech instant instead of a slow trickle, so you refill in a heartbeat mid-fight, but it also removes the safety of normal life regeneration between hits.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For physical attack builds that hit constantly and can rely on always having a target. Against a boss with long untouchable phases, instant leech leaves you with nothing to recover from.

name: Atziri's Contempt
explicitStats: Spear Skills inflict a Bloodstone Lance on Hit, up to a maximum of 30 on each target
flavourText:
"My people? I'm not doing this for them.
They belong to me. They want this for me.
Their sacrifice is a gift they give out of love
and adoration... I deserve it. I am their Queen."
description: (100-120)% increased Physical Damage Adds (83-97) to (123-153) Fire Damage Adds 1 to (193-207) Lightning Damage (10-16)% increased Attack Speed (60-80)% increased Presence Area of Effect Spear Skills inflict a Bloodstone Lance on Hit, up to a maximum of 30 on each target

beginner.whatItIs: A high-level spear with large physical, fire and lightning damage that stacks a Bloodstone Lance on every hit, up to thirty on a single target.
beginner.whyItMatters: The stacking debuff rewards you for staying on one enemy rather than moving between targets, which is exactly the pattern a boss fight forces on you anyway.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it for single-target work at level seventy-two and above. Its wide presence bonus also means it plays well with builds that punish enemies for standing near you.

name: Atziri's Disdain
explicitStats: 10% of Damage taken bypasses Energy Shield
Gain (10-15)% of maximum Life as Extra maximum Energy Shield
flavourText:
They screamed her name in adulation as they gave
their very lives. She looked on with impatience.
description: +(60-100) to maximum Mana (10-20)% increased Rarity of Items found 10% of Damage taken bypasses Energy Shield Gain (10-15)% of maximum Life as Extra maximum Energy Shield

beginner.whatItIs: A gold circlet that adds mana and item rarity, gives you extra energy shield based on a slice of your maximum life, and lets a tenth of incoming damage skip your energy shield.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a way to run energy shield on a life-based character, which normally means giving up one for the other. The bypass is the price: your shield no longer covers everything.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Good on a hybrid character with a healthy life pool who wants a shield buffer on top. Skip it on a pure energy shield build, where the bypass is pure loss.

name: Atziri's Rule
explicitStats: +(3-5) to Level of all Corrupted Spell Skill Gems
Spells which cost Life Gain (80-120)% of Damage as Extra Physical Damage
flavourText: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.
description: (10-20)% increased maximum Life (10-20)% increased Cast Speed +(20-30) to Intelligence +(3-5) to Level of all Corrupted Spell Skill Gems Spells which cost Life Gain (80-120)% of Damage as Extra Physical Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A staff that raises life and cast speed, adds several levels to corrupted spell gems, and gives spells that cost life a very large chunk of extra physical damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards two unusual choices at once, corrupting your gems and paying life for spells, and pays out enough that a build can be designed entirely around it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only on a caster that already pays life for its spells. If your skills cost mana, the headline modifier is doing nothing and you are wearing a mediocre staff.
