implicitStats: +1 to Level of all Corrupted Skill Gems

beginner.whatItIs: A high-level robe that takes only soul cores in its sockets, has no attribute requirements, adds a level to corrupted skill gems, and converts half the mana cost of those gems into life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It also gains soul core bonuses as though it were a second piece of gear chosen at random, so two copies can play completely differently depending on that hidden roll.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a corrupted-gem build with enough life recovery to pay the converted cost. Read the random equipment line before you buy one, because it decides which soul cores are worth socketing.

name: Atziri's Step
explicitStats: Gain Deflection Rating equal to (40-60)% of Evasion Rating
-(12-6)% to amount of Damage Prevented by Deflection
Cannot be Light Stunned by Deflected Hits
flavourText:
"Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
description: 30% increased Movement Speed (80-120)% increased Evasion Rating +(70-100) to maximum Life Gain Deflection Rating equal to (40-60)% of Evasion Rating -(12-6)% to amount of Damage Prevented by Deflection Cannot be Light Stunned by Deflected Hits

beginner.whatItIs: Late-game boots with high movement speed, evasion and life, which convert part of your evasion into deflection rating and stop deflected hits from lightly stunning you.
beginner.whyItMatters: They give an evasion character a second layer that works on the hits evasion fails to dodge, and the stun clause removes the stutter that normally comes with being chipped at.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear them on an evasion build at level sixty-five and up. The lower the negative deflection roll on the boots, the better, so compare that line before buying.

name: Aurseize
explicitStats: Lose 2% of maximum Life on Kill
flavourText: Wealth is not to be borne lightly.
description: (40-60)% increased Armour and Evasion (40-50)% increased Rarity of Items found Lose 2% of maximum Life on Kill

beginner.whatItIs: Layered gauntlets that add armour, evasion and a large item rarity bonus, and drain two percent of your maximum life on every kill.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is an early trade of safety for loot, and the drain is proportional, so it hurts a big life pool just as much as a small one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear them while farming easy content in the campaign, ideally with life regeneration to cover the drain. Take them off before any fight you might lose.

name: Beacon of Azis
explicitStats: Critical Hits ignore Enemy Monster Elemental Resistances
flavourText:
The homeguard signalled for aid against a surprise attack,
but it was not their dekharas that responded.
It was Solerai herself.
description: +(60-100) to maximum Mana +30 to Spirit 30% increased Light Radius Critical Hits ignore Enemy Monster Elemental Resistances

beginner.whatItIs: A solar amulet that grants spirit, mana and light radius, and lets your critical hits ignore the elemental resistances of monsters.
beginner.whyItMatters: Monster resistances are often the real reason your elemental damage feels weak, especially in maps with resistance modifiers. Ignoring them on crits removes that wall entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Excellent on an elemental build that crits reliably. If your critical hit chance is low, the amulet is only its spirit and mana lines.

name: Beetlebite
explicitStats: Aggravate Bleeding on Enemies when they Enter your Presence
flavourText:
They crawl and chitter and swarm
in the shadow of his presence.
description: (20-30)% increased Movement Speed (60-120)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield Aggravate Bleeding on Enemies when they Enter your Presence 100% increased Thorns damage

beginner.whatItIs: Boots with movement speed and hybrid defences that aggravate bleeding on any enemy who walks into your presence, and double your thorns damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Aggravation without needing the enemy to move is normally something you build around, and these boots hand it to you passively for standing near the target.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a bleed build that fights up close, especially one that also uses thorns damage. Their value is near zero on a ranged build that never lets enemies near.

name: Beira's Anguish
explicitStats: (20-25)% Chance to gain a Charge when you kill an enemy
Creates Ignited Ground for 4 seconds when used, Igniting enemies as though dealing Fire damage equal to 500% of your maximum Life
flavourText:
They found a crying child tied to a frozen pyre.
She was clad in ice, but the village was ash.
description: (20-25)% Chance to gain a Charge when you kill an enemy Creates Ignited Ground for 4 seconds when used, Igniting enemies as though dealing Fire damage equal to 500% of your maximum Life

beginner.whatItIs: A dousing charm that triggers when you catch fire and creates burning ground that ignites enemies as though you had hit them for five times your maximum life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns being set on fire, normally a pure loss, into a large area burst, and because it scales with your maximum life rather than your damage it works on any build.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it for content full of fire damage, on a character with a large life pool. It is unreliable against enemies that never ignite you.

name: Belly of the Beast
explicitStats: Life Recovery from Flasks is instant
flavourText:
There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast
description: (100-150)% increased Armour and Evasion +(100-150) to maximum Life +(100-150) to Stun Threshold Life Recovery from Flasks is instant (25-30) to (35-40) Physical Thorns damage

beginner.whatItIs: A mid-level body armour with large life, armour, evasion and stun threshold, and one line that makes every flask heal you instantly instead of over time.
beginner.whyItMatters: Instant flask recovery changes the moment you die: a normal life flask has to finish healing before it saves you, and this armour removes that delay entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: One of the best campaign chest pieces for any life-based build, and it stays strong well into maps. It gives nothing to a character running energy shield instead of life.

name: Berek's Grip
explicitStats: Hits against you have (50-35)% reduced Critical Hit Chance while you are Chilled
Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count as being boosted by Shocked Ground
flavourText:
"Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath
In the embrace of oblivious Frost
Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards
Storm raged in vain
While Berek slept."
- Berek and the Untamed
description: +(10-20) to Dexterity and Intelligence +(10-20)% to Cold and Lightning Resistances Hits against you have (50-35)% reduced Critical Hit Chance while you are Chilled Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count as being boosted by Shocked Ground

beginner.whatItIs: A two-stone ring covering cold and lightning resistance that also cuts the critical hit chance of enemies attacking you while you are chilled.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chill is usually something that happens to you rather than something you want, and this ring makes being chilled a defensive state instead of a punishment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it into cold-heavy content, or on a build that chills itself on purpose. It also lets wind skills treat shocked ground as their boost condition, which matters only if you use them.

name: Berek's Pass
explicitStats: Regenerate (1-2)% of maximum Life per second while Ignited
Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count as being boosted by Chilled Ground
flavourText:
"From Frost's ice-bound pass
Berek taunted and jeered
Until furious Flame scaled the mountain
Berek escaped through the thaw
And Frost's tortured moans."
- Berek and the Untamed
description: +(10-20) to Strength and Intelligence +(10-20)% to Fire and Cold Resistances Regenerate (1-2)% of maximum Life per second while Ignited Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count as being boosted by Chilled Ground

beginner.whatItIs: A two-stone ring covering fire and cold resistance that regenerates a percentage of your maximum life every second while you are ignited.
beginner.whyItMatters: Ignite is one of the fastest ways to die in this game, and turning that state into a healing window flips the most dangerous ailment into a small advantage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it for fire-heavy maps and bosses. The regeneration only runs while you are actually burning, so it is a mitigation tool, not a general healing source.

name: Berek's Respite
explicitStats: (15-25)% increased Critical Damage Bonus while Shocked
Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count as being boosted by Ignited Ground
flavourText:
"With Flame licking at his heels
Berek berated the clouds
Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains
And Berek held on tight
As Fire screamed and steamed
And fled."
- Berek and the Untamed
description: +(10-20) to Strength and Dexterity +(10-20)% to Fire and Lightning Resistances (15-25)% increased Critical Damage Bonus while Shocked Wind Skills which can be boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces count as being boosted by Ignited Ground

beginner.whatItIs: A two-stone ring covering fire and lightning resistance that increases your critical damage bonus while you are shocked.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being shocked means taking more damage, so the ring gives you a reason to accept that risk instead of avoiding it, and pays out in your own critical hits.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a critical-strike build fighting lightning enemies, or one that shocks itself deliberately. Without a way to be shocked on demand, the modifier will rarely be live.

name: Beyond Reach
implicitStats: (20-30)% increased Critical Hit Chance for Attacks
explicitStats: Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Freeze Buildup
Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Electrocute Buildup
Attacks Gain (10-20)% of Physical Damage as extra Chaos Damage
flavourText:
The limit of our knowledge is a barrier
that protects us from ourselves.
description: (15-10)% reduced Attack Speed Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Freeze Buildup Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Electrocute Buildup Attacks Gain (10-20)% of Physical Damage as extra Chaos Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A late quiver that trades attack speed for critical hit chance, adds chaos damage to your attacks, and lets chaos damage contribute to freezing and electrocuting enemies.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chaos damage normally cannot freeze or electrocute anything, so this quiver hands a chaos build access to two crowd-control effects it is otherwise locked out of.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a chaos-damage bow build at high level that wants to lock enemies down as well as kill them. The lost attack speed makes it a poor fit for builds that rely on a fast rhythm.

name: Bijouborne
flavourText: Trifle not with the trinket mage.
description: +(50-100) to maximum Mana (50-10)% reduced Charm Effect Duration +2 Charm Slots +(15-25) to Dexterity (20-30)% increased Charm Charges gained

beginner.whatItIs: A belt that adds two extra charm slots and mana, gains charm charges faster, and shortens how long each charm's effect lasts.
beginner.whyItMatters: Charm slots are the scarcest utility resource on a belt, so two extra ones let you cover several ailments at once instead of choosing between them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it when you need broad ailment coverage more than long individual charm uptime, for example when pushing unknown map modifiers.

name: Birth of Fury
explicitStats: Drop Ignited Ground while moving, which lasts 8 seconds and Ignites as though dealing Fire Damage equal to 10% of your maximum Life
flavourText:
As the sun rises and the light approaches,
so too shall your enemies fear you.
description: 20% increased Movement Speed +(40-60) to maximum Life +(20-30)% to Fire Resistance Drop Ignited Ground while moving, which lasts 8 seconds and Ignites as though dealing Fire Damage equal to 10% of your maximum Life

beginner.whatItIs: Boots that add life, fire resistance and movement speed, and leave burning ground behind you as you run, igniting enemies for a tenth of your maximum life.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trail scales with your own life pool rather than with your weapon, so it does real damage on a tanky character who was not built for fire at all.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear them on a high-life character clearing packs while moving. Against a stationary boss the trail rarely lands, so it is a clear-speed item first.

name: Birthright Buckle
explicitStats: Life Flasks used while on Low Life apply Recovery Instantly
Mana Flasks used while on Low Mana apply Recovery Instantly
flavourText: Some families have peculiar gifts...
description: +(100-150) to Armour (15-10)% reduced Flask Charges used (20-30)% increased Flask Charges gained Life Flasks used while on Low Life apply Recovery Instantly Mana Flasks used while on Low Mana apply Recovery Instantly

beginner.whatItIs: An early belt that gains flask charges faster, spends fewer of them, and makes life and mana flasks heal instantly when you are already in trouble.
beginner.whyItMatters: Conditional instant recovery is the safest version of that effect: you keep the normal healing when you are fine and get the emergency version exactly when you are low.
beginner.whenToUseIt: An excellent campaign belt from level fourteen onwards, and a cheap safety net for any character learning a new fight.

name: Bitterbloom
explicitStats: Energy Shield Recharge starts when you use a Mana Flask
flavourText: The soul cannot flourish in a doubting mind.
description: (50-100)% increased Energy Shield +(50-100) to maximum Mana 50% increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate Energy Shield Recharge starts when you use a Mana Flask

beginner.whatItIs: An early robe that adds energy shield, mana and recharge rate, and starts your energy shield recharging the moment you drink a mana flask.
beginner.whyItMatters: Energy shield normally only refills after several seconds without being hit, which is exactly what does not happen in a fight. A flask press bypasses that wait entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a low-level energy shield caster who wants a recovery button. Keep a cheap mana flask on the bar purely to trigger it.

name: Black Sun Crest
flavourText:
The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
description: (50-80)% increased Armour 20% reduced Light Radius (5-15)% increased Strength (5-15)% increased Dexterity (5-15)% increased Intelligence

beginner.whatItIs: A helmet that increases all three attributes by a percentage rather than a flat amount, adds armour, and shrinks your light radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: Percentage attribute scaling grows with the rest of your gear, so this helmet is worth more the more attributes you already have, unlike the flat bonuses it competes with.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it on a build already stacking attributes for damage or requirements. On a low-attribute character the percentage is applied to almost nothing.

name: Blackbraid
explicitStats: +(100-150)% of Armour also applies to Elemental Damage
flavourText: An Ezomyte endures.
description: +(40-60) to Armour +(5-15) to Strength +(5-15) to Intelligence +10% to all Elemental Resistances +(40-60) to Stun Threshold +(100-150)% of Armour also applies to Elemental Damage

beginner.whatItIs: An early fur plate that adds armour, attributes, all elemental resistances and stun threshold, and applies your armour to elemental damage as well as physical.
beginner.whyItMatters: Armour normally only reduces physical hits. Letting it work against fire, cold and lightning turns a single defensive stat into a defence against nearly everything.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Very strong for a low-level armour character in the campaign. The percentage is applied to your armour rating, so it grows with the rest of your armour gear.

name: Blackflame
explicitStats: Ignite you inflict deals Chaos Damage instead of Fire Damage
Withered you inflict also increases Fire Damage taken
Withered does not expire on Enemies Ignited by you
flavourText:
Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.
description: (15-30)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Ignite you inflict deals Chaos Damage instead of Fire Damage (80-100)% increased Ignite Magnitude (75-60)% reduced Ignite Duration on Enemies Withered you inflict also increases Fire Damage taken Withered does not expire on Enemies Ignited by you

beginner.whatItIs: An amethyst ring that makes your ignites deal chaos damage instead of fire, burns much harder over a much shorter time, and stops wither from expiring on enemies you have ignited.
beginner.whyItMatters: Switching ignite to chaos sidesteps fire resistance entirely, and permanent wither on burning targets means their chaos resistance keeps falling while they burn.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Build around it: it needs an ignite source and a wither source to reach its potential. On a plain fire build it usually reduces your damage rather than raising it.

name: Blackgleam
implicitStats: Adds 3 to 5 Fire damage to Attacks
explicitStats: Adds (3-5) to (6-9) Fire damage to Attacks
Attacks Gain (5-10)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage
flavourText:
Molten feathers, veiled spark,
Hissing arrows from the dark.
description: Adds (3-5) to (6-9) Fire damage to Attacks +(30-50) to maximum Mana 50% increased Flammability Magnitude Projectiles Pierce all Ignited enemies Attacks Gain (5-10)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A low-level quiver that adds fire damage to attacks, raises flammability magnitude by half, and lets your projectiles pass through any ignited enemy.
beginner.whyItMatters: Piercing through burning targets means a single shot can hit an entire lined-up pack instead of stopping at the first monster, which is a large early clear-speed jump.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Perfect for a campaign bow build that ignites, from level eight onward. It falls off once you have a real source of pierce or chain.

name: Blackheart
implicitStats: Adds 1 to 4 Physical Damage to Attacks
explicitStats: Adds (4-6) to (8-10) Chaos Damage to Attacks
25% chance to Intimidate Enemies for 4 seconds on Hit
flavourText: Fear is highly infectious.
description: (3-6) Life Regeneration per second Adds (4-6) to (8-10) Chaos Damage to Attacks 25% chance to Intimidate Enemies for 4 seconds on Hit

beginner.whatItIs: A level-one ring that regenerates life, adds chaos damage to your attacks, and sometimes intimidates enemies you hit so they take more physical damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chaos damage bypasses energy shield, and almost nothing at low level resists it, so a small flat amount goes a surprisingly long way in the first act.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it from the moment you find it until your gear outgrows it. The regeneration alone justifies the slot in early acts.

name: Blistering Bond
explicitStats: You take Fire Damage instead of Physical Damage from Bleeding
Fire Damage also Contributes to Bleeding Magnitude
Bleeding you inflict deals Fire Damage instead of Physical Damage
flavourText:
"The Brotherhood of Silence does not set out to torture our targets.
Excruciating pain is simply a byproduct of certain... necessary methods."
description: +(40-60) to maximum Life +(20-30)% to Fire Resistance -(15-10)% to Cold Resistance You take Fire Damage instead of Physical Damage from Bleeding Fire Damage also Contributes to Bleeding Magnitude Bleeding you inflict deals Fire Damage instead of Physical Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A ruby ring that gives fire resistance and life, then rewrites bleeding on both sides: bleeding damages you as fire instead of physical, and the bleeds you inflict deal fire damage too.
beginner.whyItMatters: It moves a whole damage type out of physical mitigation and into fire mitigation, which is easier to cap, and it lets a bleed build scale with fire damage stats.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a bleed build that also invests in fire damage. The small cold resistance penalty is the usual reason people pass on it.

name: Blood of the Warrior
explicitStats: Effect is not removed when Unreserved Life is Filled
Gain (3-5) Rage when Hit by an Enemy during effect
No Inherent loss of Rage during effect
(15-30)% of Damage taken during effect Recouped as Life
flavourText:
"Tukohama may be asleep, but he still gives us his strength. A small
needle, an offering, and a vial... drink deeply, my son, and you
will more than survive the coming battle... you will thrive."
description: 90% less Life Recovered Effect is not removed when Unreserved Life is Filled Gain (3-5) Rage when Hit by an Enemy during effect No Inherent loss of Rage during effect (15-30)% of Damage taken during effect Recouped as Life (25-50)% increased Duration

beginner.whatItIs: A life flask that heals almost nothing and instead keeps its effect running, generating rage when you are hit, stopping rage from decaying, and recouping part of the damage you take as life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts a healing slot into a rage engine, which is the opposite trade to what a life flask normally makes, and the recoup replaces the healing you gave up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only on a rage build, and only once you have a second source of actual healing. It is not a life flask any more.

name: Blood Price
explicitStats: Enemies in your Presence have at least 10% of Life Reserved
flavourText: An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.
description: (80-120)% increased Armour (10-15) Life Regeneration per second +(100-150) to Stun Threshold (30-60)% increased Presence Area of Effect Enemies in your Presence have at least 10% of Life Reserved

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy helmet with armour, life regeneration and stun threshold that reserves at least a tenth of the life of every enemy standing in your presence.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reserved life is life those monsters can never use, so every enemy near you effectively starts the fight already wounded, and the effect scales with how many are close.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Best on a melee character who fights inside packs, especially one with a large presence radius. It does nothing for anything you kill at range.

name: Bloodbarrier
explicitStats: Inflict Corrupted Blood for 5 seconds on Block, dealing 50% of your maximum Life as Physical damage per second
flavourText:
A window onto a realm of red,
where countless voices scream...
description: (10-15)% increased Block chance +(13-17)% to Chaos Resistance (5-10) Life Regeneration per second Inflict Corrupted Blood for 5 seconds on Block, dealing 50% of your maximum Life as Physical damage per second

beginner.whatItIs: An early buckler with block chance, chaos resistance and life regeneration that inflicts corrupted blood on whoever you block, dealing physical damage based on your own maximum life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes blocking an attack rather than just a defensive one, and because the damage scales with your life it stays relevant as you grow rather than as your weapon improves.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a high-life blocking character in the campaign. You need to actually be blocking, so it wants block chance elsewhere in the build too.

name: Blueflame Bracers
explicitStats: 100% of Fire Damage Converted to Cold Damage
flavourText: The secret was lost with its maker.
description: +20 to maximum Energy Shield +(10-20) to Intelligence +(5-15)% to Fire Resistance +(5-15)% to Cold Resistance 100% of Fire Damage Converted to Cold Damage

beginner.whatItIs: Gloves with energy shield, intelligence and split resistances that convert all of your fire damage into cold damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Full conversion lets a fire skill be scaled by cold stats, freeze enemies, and ignore fire resistance, which turns a whole class of skills into cold skills.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear them when you want a fire skill's mechanics with a cold build's scaling, typically a freeze build. They are worthless if you deal no fire damage.

name: Bluetongue
explicitStats: 100% increased Attack Damage while not on Low Mana
flavourText: War inevitably takes an untold toll on the soul.
description: Adds (4-6) to (7-10) Physical Damage 10% increased Attack Speed Lose 3 Mana per Enemy Killed 100% increased Attack Damage while not on Low Mana

beginner.whatItIs: A starter shortsword that loses mana on every kill and deals double attack damage as long as you are not on low mana.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a doubling of your damage with an unusual condition attached, and the mana drain is what turns that condition into an actual decision rather than a free bonus.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A superb first weapon in act one if your mana pool and regeneration can outrun the drain. It falls away quickly once real weapons appear.

name: Bones of Ullr
explicitStats: (20-30)% increased Reservation Efficiency of Skills which create Undead Minions
flavourText:
The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.
description: (5-15)% increased Movement Speed (40-60)% increased Energy Shield +(20-40) to maximum Life +(20-40) to maximum Mana (20-30)% increased Reservation Efficiency of Skills which create Undead Minions

beginner.whatItIs: Sandals with movement speed, energy shield, life and mana that make skills creating undead minions cheaper to reserve.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reservation efficiency is what decides how many minions you can hold at once, so these boots effectively raise your army size rather than each minion's power.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an undead minion build at low level, where reservation is tightest. Non-undead minion builds get nothing from the headline line.

name: Brain Rattler
explicitStats: All damage with this Weapon causes Electrocution buildup
flavourText: The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.
description: Adds (18-22) to (24-28) Physical Damage Adds 1 to (50-55) Lightning Damage (10-15)% increased Attack Speed All damage with this Weapon causes Electrocution buildup

beginner.whatItIs: A two-handed mace with physical and lightning damage that makes every kind of damage it deals build electrocution.
beginner.whyItMatters: Electrocute normally needs lightning damage specifically. This mace lets your physical damage build it too, so a plain heavy hit can stun a monster into an electrocuted stagger.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Excellent from level sixteen for a slow, big-hit mace build that wants crowd control it did not have to pay for.

name: Bramblejack
explicitStats: 250% of Melee Physical Damage taken reflected to Attacker
Regenerate 5% of maximum Life per second while Surrounded
flavourText: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
description: +(60-100) to maximum Life +(60-100) to Stun Threshold Cannot Evade Enemy Attacks 250% of Melee Physical Damage taken reflected to Attacker Regenerate 5% of maximum Life per second while Surrounded

beginner.whatItIs: A level-one cuirass that adds life and stun threshold, stops you evading anything, reflects two and a half times the melee physical damage you take, and regenerates you heavily while surrounded.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a deliberately backwards armour: the more monsters swarm you, the more damage they take and the more you heal, but you never dodge a single hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an early character who wants to stand in a crowd rather than avoid one. Its value collapses once single big hits, not swarms, are what kills you.

name: Breath of the Mountains
implicitStats: Used when you take Cold damage from a Hit
explicitStats: Grants a Power Charge on use
flavourText:
"To scrape the sky,
to touch the clouds themselves,
is to know true freedom."
- Mutewind saying
description: (15-10)% reduced Charges per use Grants a Power Charge on use

beginner.whatItIs: A sapphire charm that fires when cold damage hits you, uses fewer charges than normal, and grants a power charge when it activates.
beginner.whyItMatters: A power charge is a real damage and critical bonus, so this charm turns incoming cold damage into an offensive trigger rather than a purely defensive save.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Slot it in cold-heavy content on a build that uses power charges. Without power charge scaling it is only a cold cleanse.

name: Briarpatch
flavourText: The druids walk the Grelwood without fear.
description: (10-20)% increased Movement Speed +(40-60) to maximum Life +(60-80) to Stun Threshold +25% to Thorns Critical Hit Chance (10-15) to (20-25) Physical Thorns damage

beginner.whatItIs: Early boots with movement speed, life and stun threshold that add physical thorns damage and let your thorns critically strike far more often.
beginner.whyItMatters: Thorns damage is normally flat and unexciting, and critical thorns is one of the few ways to make it scale into something worth building for.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take them on a thorns character from level eleven. On any other build they are just a life and movement speed pair of boots.

name: Briskwrap
explicitStats: Gain Deflection Rating equal to (20-30)% of Evasion Rating
flavourText:
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity
of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men."
- Taruk of the Wildmen
description: (60-100)% increased Evasion Rating (40-60)% increased Flask Life Recovery rate (40-60)% increased Flask Mana Recovery rate +(20-30) to Dexterity +(20-30)% to Cold Resistance Gain Deflection Rating equal to (20-30)% of Evasion Rating

beginner.whatItIs: A rhoahide coat that adds evasion, dexterity and cold resistance, greatly speeds up how fast your flasks refill you, and converts part of your evasion into deflection rating.
beginner.whyItMatters: Faster flask recovery means the heal lands before the next hit rather than after it, which is often the whole difference between recovering and dying.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A strong mid-campaign chest for an evasion character. The deflection line makes it better the more evasion the rest of your gear supplies.

name: Bristleboar
explicitStats: Gain 5 Rage when Hit by an Enemy
Gain 10 Rage when Critically Hit by an Enemy
flavourText: When cornered and desperate, look within for the rage to break loose.
description: 50% reduced Evasion Rating +(40-60) to maximum Life (3-5) Life Regeneration per second Gain 5 Rage when Hit by an Enemy Gain 10 Rage when Critically Hit by an Enemy

beginner.whatItIs: A level-one leather vest that halves your evasion, adds life and regeneration, and generates rage whenever an enemy hits you, with a bigger burst on a critical hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Most rage generation asks you to attack. This asks you to be attacked, which is the easier condition to meet while you are still learning a fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a rage build starting out, where the halved evasion costs almost nothing because you were not evading much anyway.

name: Bronzebeard
explicitStats: (50-35)% reduced Effect of Chill on you
(50-35)% reduced Magnitude of Ignite on you
(50-35)% reduced effect of Shock on you
flavourText: Heavy is the head.
description: 10% reduced Movement Speed (50-100)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +100 to maximum Life (50-35)% reduced Effect of Chill on you (50-35)% reduced Magnitude of Ignite on you (50-35)% reduced effect of Shock on you

beginner.whatItIs: A horned crown that slows you slightly, adds armour, energy shield and a flat hundred life, and heavily reduces how strongly chill, ignite and shock affect you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Ailment effect is what makes elemental hits linger, and cutting all three at once is broad protection that a single resistance roll cannot match.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it from level ten through content full of elemental ailments. The movement penalty makes it a poor fit for builds that survive by moving.

name: Brutus' Lead Sprinkler
explicitStats: Hits with this Weapon have 5% chance to Trigger Molten Shower per 25 Strength
5 to 10 Added Attack Fire Damage per 25 Strength
flavourText:
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often
required to garnish the perfect confession."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
description: Hits with this Weapon have 5% chance to Trigger Molten Shower per 25 Strength (80-120)% increased Physical Damage (5-10)% increased Attack Speed +(15-25) to Strength 5 to 10 Added Attack Fire Damage per 25 Strength

beginner.whatItIs: A morning star whose added fire damage and chance to trigger Molten Shower both scale with your strength, in blocks of twenty-five.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts an attribute you were probably stacking anyway into both extra damage and a free triggered skill, so strength stops being purely a requirement stat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a high-strength melee character at level forty-five and up. On a low-strength build the weapon does almost nothing special.

name: Brynhand's Mark
flavourText: The mark of the smith was widely known.
description: Adds (10-14) to (16-20) Physical Damage +(30-50) to Accuracy Rating +(10-20) to Strength Causes Double Stun Buildup

beginner.whatItIs: A starter club with added physical damage, accuracy and strength whose special line doubles the stun buildup it causes.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stun is how a slow melee character stops a dangerous enemy from acting, and doubling the build-up means you interrupt attacks you would otherwise have to dodge.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A very strong first mace in act one, especially against rare monsters that hit hard but stun normally.

name: Bursting Decay
explicitStats: Lose 5% of maximum Life per second
Attacks have added Physical damage equal to 3% of maximum Life
flavourText:
"All Beidat desires is a foothold, a grip on your flesh,
on the world... he will offer you anything to get it..."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page thirty
description: (15-25)% increased Rarity of Items found +(17-23)% to Chaos Resistance Lose 5% of maximum Life per second Attacks have added Physical damage equal to 3% of maximum Life

beginner.whatItIs: An unset ring granting an extra skill slot, item rarity and chaos resistance, which drains five percent of your maximum life every second and adds physical damage to your attacks equal to three percent of your maximum life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a straight trade of survivability for damage that scales with your life pool, so the bigger your life, the more it gives and the more it takes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only with recovery strong enough to beat a five percent per second drain, which usually means heavy leech or regeneration. Without that it will kill you in an empty room.

name: Bushwhack
flavourText:
Banished for his tragic failure,
Erian learned to hunt to survive.
description: (15-25)% increased Movement Speed (50-80)% increased Evasion Rating +(10-20) to Dexterity Physical Damage is Pinning

beginner.whatItIs: Evasion boots with movement speed and dexterity that make all of your physical damage contribute to pinning enemies in place.
beginner.whyItMatters: Pin is a hard lockdown, and normally only specific skills apply it. These boots hand the effect to any physical attack you already use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take them on a physical build that wants control as well as damage, especially against fast enemies you cannot outrun.

name: Byrnabas
flavourText: The Brinerot sail without fear of storms.
description: +(40-60) to maximum Mana +(30-40)% to Lightning Resistance (7-12) Life Regeneration per second Cannot be Shocked

beginner.whatItIs: A wide belt with mana, lightning resistance and life regeneration that makes you immune to being shocked.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shock increases all damage you take, so removing it outright is a much larger defensive gain than the same points spent on lightning resistance alone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it into any lightning-heavy map or boss from level fourteen. Its value is entirely situational, so keep it as a swap piece.

name: Cadiro's Gambit
explicitStats: Each Arrow fired is a Crescendo, Splinter, Reversing, Diamond, Covetous, or Blunt Arrow
flavourText:
"One can never fully eliminate Chance, but with the right
machinations, all the outcomes may be turned in your favour..."
- Cadiro Perandus"
description: Each Arrow fired is a Crescendo, Splinter, Reversing, Diamond, Covetous, or Blunt Arrow

beginner.whatItIs: A high-level quiver that adds attack speed and turns every arrow you fire into one of six special arrow types, chosen at random.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each arrow type behaves differently, so your damage stops being a single predictable number and becomes an average across six effects, some far better than others for a given fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a bow build that fires often enough for the average to smooth out. On a slow, single-shot build the randomness is a liability.

name: Calgyra's Arc
flavourText: "There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
description: (60-100)% increased Evasion Rating +(60-100) to maximum Mana +(10-20) to Intelligence Infinite Parry Range 50% increased Parried Debuff Duration

beginner.whatItIs: A late buckler with evasion, mana and intelligence that removes the range limit on parrying and extends the debuff a parry applies.
beginner.whyItMatters: Parry is normally a close-range reaction. Infinite range turns it into a tool you can use against anything on screen, which changes how the shield is played entirely.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a parry-focused character at level fifty-two and up. If you never parry, it is just an evasion buckler.

name: Call of the Brotherhood
explicitStats: 100% of Lightning Damage Converted to Cold Damage
flavourText:
Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.
description: +(10-20) to Intelligence (25-35)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate (20-30)% increased Freeze Buildup 100% of Lightning Damage Converted to Cold Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A topaz ring with lightning resistance, intelligence and mana regeneration that converts all of your lightning damage into cold damage and raises freeze build-up.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets a lightning skill freeze enemies and scale with cold stats, swapping a shock build's crowd control for a freeze build's, without changing your skill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a lightning caster who wants to freeze rather than shock. The conversion is total, so plan your damage passives around cold afterwards.

name: Candlemaker
flavourText: You can be the wick or the wax. Either way, your light goes out and mine goes on.
description: (50-80)% increased Energy Shield (20-40)% increased Fire Damage (20-10)% reduced Cold Damage +(20-40)% to Fire Resistance -(20-10)% to Cold Resistance Flammability Magnitude is doubled

beginner.whatItIs: Gloves with energy shield that raise fire damage and fire resistance, lower cold damage and cold resistance, and make the Flammability curse land at doubled magnitude.
beginner.whyItMatters: Doubling flammability means the fire resistance you strip from enemies is twice as deep, which is usually a bigger damage gain than the increased fire damage line itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a fire build that applies flammability, from level twelve. The cold penalties make them a poor fit for anything that deals both damage types.

name: Carnage Heart
flavourText:
Forged from the blood of countless wars,
its thirst has only begun.
description: 20% reduced maximum Life +(10-20) to all Attributes +(10-20)% to all Elemental Resistances (100-200)% increased amount of Life Leeched (25-50)% increased Damage while Leeching

beginner.whatItIs: An amber amulet that cuts a fifth of your maximum life and returns all attributes, all elemental resistances, far more leech, and more damage while leeching.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a very broad amulet with one painful cost, and the increased leech is meant to pay back the life you lost, which only works if you are leeching constantly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an attack build with reliable leech that needs resistances and attributes in one slot. Avoid it on a build that leeches only occasionally.

name: Carrion Call
explicitStats: Minions' Resistances are equal to yours
flavourText: Obedience stretches beyond the grave.
description: +(30-40) to maximum Energy Shield Minions have (20-30)% increased maximum Life (20-30)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Minions deal (20-30)% increased Damage Minions' Resistances are equal to yours

beginner.whatItIs: An engraved focus that adds energy shield and mana regeneration, gives minions more life and damage, and sets your minions' resistances equal to your own.
beginner.whyItMatters: Minion resistances are otherwise almost impossible to raise, and this line makes every resistance point you buy for yourself protect your whole army too.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Excellent on any minion build from level sixteen, and it stays relevant as long as your own resistances are capped.

name: Cat O' Nine Tails
explicitStats: Regenerate 5% of maximum Life per second if you have been Hit Recently
Life Recovery other than Flasks cannot Recover Life to above Low Life
Gain Physical Thorns damage equal to 8% - 12% of maximum Life
flavourText:
A Templar thinks he's righteous for flogging
himself once for every ten lashings he gives.
description: +(120-200) to maximum Life Regenerate 5% of maximum Life per second if you have been Hit Recently (25-50)% increased Life Recovery rate Life Recovery other than Flasks cannot Recover Life to above Low Life Gain Physical Thorns damage equal to 8% - 12% of maximum Life

beginner.whatItIs: A late belt with a large life bonus and heavy regeneration after being hit, which caps all non-flask recovery at your low life threshold and grants thorns damage based on your maximum life.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being locked at low life is a serious cost that also switches on every low-life bonus in the game, so the belt is a build-defining choice rather than an upgrade.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only on a build designed to sit at low life, with flasks as the way back up. Wearing it on anything else is a permanent handicap.

name: Chainsting
explicitStats: All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Pin Buildup
(20-30)% increased Projectile Speed with this Weapon
flavourText: The Sacred Hunt ends with mercy.
description: Adds (13-17) to (22-28) Physical Damage +(100-150) to Accuracy Rating 10% increased Attack Speed All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Pin Buildup (20-30)% increased Projectile Speed with this Weapon

beginner.whatItIs: A hunting spear with added physical damage, accuracy and attack speed that makes every hit contribute to pinning the target and speeds up its projectiles.
beginner.whyItMatters: Pin locks an enemy in place, and getting it from the weapon itself means you keep the control without giving up a skill slot to a dedicated ability.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A strong campaign spear from level ten for a build that wants to stop enemies reaching it.

name: Chernobog's Pillar
explicitStats: Gain 1% of damage as Fire damage per 1% Chance to Block
flavourText:
Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame
description: (100-150)% increased Armour +(30-40)% to Fire Resistance +(23-29)% to Chaos Resistance +(150-200) to Stun Threshold Gain 1% of damage as Fire damage per 1% Chance to Block

beginner.whatItIs: A tower shield with heavy armour, fire and chaos resistance and stun threshold that converts each percent of block chance you have into a percent of your damage gained as extra fire damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is one of the few items that turns a defensive stat directly into offence, so investing further in block makes you hit harder as well as survive longer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a high block character at level sixty-five and up. With low block chance the conversion is negligible and the shield is only armour.

name: Chober Chaber
explicitStats: +(2-3) to Level of all Minion Skills
Increases and Reductions to Minion Damage also affect you
flavourText: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.
description: +100 Intelligence Requirement Adds (58-65) to (102-110) Physical Damage +(80-100) to maximum Mana +50 to Spirit +(2-3) to Level of all Minion Skills Increases and Reductions to Minion Damage also affect you

beginner.whatItIs: A two-handed mace with a heavy intelligence requirement that grants minion skill levels, spirit and mana, and makes every increase to minion damage apply to your own damage too.
beginner.whyItMatters: It merges two build plans that normally compete for passive points, so the tree you take for your minions is also the tree that scales your attacks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a hybrid summoner who also fights, from level thirty-three. The intelligence requirement is steep, so check you can actually equip it.

name: Choir of the Storm
explicitStats: Critical Hits Ignore Enemy Monster Lightning Resistance
Trigger Lightning Bolt Skill on Critical Hit
flavourText:
But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.
description: +(50-100)% to Lightning Resistance Critical Hits Ignore Enemy Monster Lightning Resistance Trigger Lightning Bolt Skill on Critical Hit

beginner.whatItIs: A jade amulet with a very large lightning resistance bonus that triggers a lightning bolt whenever you critically hit, and lets your crits ignore enemy lightning resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: The triggered bolt is free damage on a hit you were making anyway, and ignoring monster resistance removes the usual reason lightning damage underperforms in maps.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For any critical-strike build at level fifty-five and up, whether or not it already deals lightning damage.

name: Clear Skies
implicitStats: Adds a Mirror of Delirium to a Map
explicitStats: Delirium Fog in your Maps never dissipates
Delirium in Map increases (-10-10)% faster with distance from the mirror
flavourText: A simple instruction that will purify an entire region, making it safe and kind for weary travellers.
description: Delirium Fog in your Maps never dissipates Delirium in Map increases (-10-10)% faster with distance from the mirror

beginner.whatItIs: A delirium tablet that adds a mirror of delirium to your maps and stops the delirium fog from ever thinning out.
beginner.whyItMatters: Delirium rewards scale with how deep into the fog you get, and normally the fog fades as you move away from the mirror, capping the reward.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Apply it when you are farming delirium deliberately and your character can survive a map that stays fully deliriumed from start to finish.

name: Cloak of Defiance
explicitStats: 50% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life
flavourText:
When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.
description: (50-100)% increased Energy Shield +(100-150) to maximum Mana (50-100)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate 50% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life

beginner.whatItIs: A late robe with energy shield, mana and mana regeneration that takes half of every hit from your mana pool before it touches your life.
beginner.whyItMatters: It effectively adds your mana pool to your health bar, which is why mana becomes a defensive stat on any build wearing it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a caster with a large mana pool and strong regeneration. If your mana empties, the protection stops, so it needs mana investment rather than just the chest.

name: Cloak of Flame
explicitStats: 50% of Physical Damage taken as Fire Damage
flavourText: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
description: +(30-50) to maximum Energy Shield +(30-50)% to Fire Resistance (30-50)% reduced Ignite Duration on you 50% of Physical Damage taken as Fire Damage 25 to 35 Fire Thorns damage

beginner.whatItIs: A silk robe with energy shield and fire resistance that shortens ignites on you, converts half the physical damage you take into fire damage, and adds fire thorns.
beginner.whyItMatters: Physical damage is the hardest type to mitigate, and moving half of it into fire lets your fire resistance do the work instead of your armour.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it in physical-heavy content once your fire resistance is capped. Uncapped fire resistance turns this armour into a liability.

name: Coat of Red
explicitStats: 25% chance to be inflicted with Bleeding when Hit
flavourText:
For those noble families obsessed
with keeping their bloodline pure,
there was a price to pay...
description: (80-100)% increased Armour and Evasion +(80-100) to maximum Life +(75-150) to Stun Threshold 25% chance to be inflicted with Bleeding when Hit

beginner.whatItIs: A starter chain mail with armour, evasion, life and stun threshold that gives you a one-in-four chance to start bleeding whenever you are hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: The defensive numbers are excellent for level one, and the self-bleed is the price, which is manageable early because monsters hit lightly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A strong first chest in act one, especially if you carry a charm that removes bleeding.

name: Collapsing Horizon
explicitStats: +(2-4) to Level of all Elemental Skills
Trigger skills refund half of Energy spent
flavourText: The edges bend, the world flexes, the infinite spills into view.
description: 100% increased Elemental Damage +(5-10)% to Critical Hit Chance +(2-4) to Level of all Elemental Skills Trigger skills refund half of Energy spent

beginner.whatItIs: A late quarterstaff that increases elemental damage, adds critical hit chance and elemental skill levels, and refunds half the energy spent by triggered skills.
beginner.whyItMatters: Energy is what limits how often triggered skills fire, so halving the cost roughly doubles how often your automatic effects go off.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an elemental build that leans on triggered skills, from level sixty-five. It gives nothing to a build that triggers nothing.

name: Constricting Command
explicitStats: Require (4-2) fewer enemies to be Surrounded
flavourText:
"Be vigilant, Nezahul! When the serpent is cornered, does it give up?
No... It waits. Then it bites the first hand it finds.
The danger of numbers is all in your mind!"
- Viper Napuatzi, instructing Royal Commander Nezahul
description: +(80-120) to maximum Life +(10-15) to all Attributes (8-12) Life Regeneration per second Require (4-2) fewer enemies to be Surrounded

beginner.whatItIs: A viper cap with life, all attributes and life regeneration that lowers how many enemies must surround you before you count as surrounded.
beginner.whyItMatters: Several strong passives and items only switch on while you are surrounded, and this helmet makes that state reachable against small packs instead of only large ones.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it when your build has surrounded-condition bonuses. Without any, it is a solid but ordinary life helmet.

name: Controlled Metamorphosis
explicitStats: Only affects Passives in (Very Small-Massive) Ring
Passives in Radius can be Allocated without being connected to your tree
flavourText:
Our world was dying, but we chose to survive.
We broke free from the chains within.
description: Only affects Passives in (Very Small-Massive) Ring Passives in Radius can be Allocated without being connected to your tree -(20-5)% to all Elemental Resistances

beginner.whatItIs: A diamond jewel that lets passive skills within its radius be allocated without connecting them to the rest of your tree, at the cost of elemental resistances.
beginner.whyItMatters: It buys access to a distant cluster of passives without paying for the path there, which can be worth dozens of points on a tree that would otherwise need a long detour.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when the cluster it reaches is genuinely strong for your build and you can afford the resistance loss. The lower the negative roll, the better.

name: Cornathaum
flavourText: Pain brings clarity.
description: (10-20)% increased Rarity of Items found +(40-50) to Intelligence 30% increased Light Radius 5% increased Experience gain

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy crown with item rarity, a very large intelligence bonus, extra light radius and five percent increased experience gain.
beginner.whyItMatters: Increased experience is rare and compounds over an entire levelling stretch, and the intelligence bonus quietly solves gear requirements for a non-intelligence character.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it while levelling from thirty-three onward, and while farming content you already clear safely. Swap it out when you need defensive stats on the helmet slot.

name: Corona of the Red Sun
explicitStats: Leeching Life from your Hits causes Allies in your Presence to also Leech the same amount of Life
flavourText:
Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices,
but all who witnessed shared in exultation.
description: +(100-150) to Accuracy Rating +(60-80) to maximum Life +(20-25)% to Fire Resistance 25% increased Light Radius Leeching Life from your Hits causes Allies in your Presence to also Leech the same amount of Life

beginner.whatItIs: A greathelm with accuracy, life and fire resistance whose special line makes nearby allies leech the same amount of life your own hits leech.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts your personal recovery into party recovery, which is an unusual support effect for a helmet, and it costs you nothing you were not already doing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For group play at level sixty-five and up on a leeching attack build. Alone, the modifier does nothing.

name: Corpsewade
flavourText: Natural decay can be twisted to dark ends.
description: 10% increased Movement Speed (30-50)% increased Armour +(5-10) to Strength Trigger Decompose every 1.2 metres travelled

beginner.whatItIs: Early greaves with movement speed, armour and strength that cast Decompose automatically every metre or so that you travel.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a free source of corpses and chaos damage tied to walking, which means a build that wants corpses no longer has to spend a skill slot generating them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take them on a corpse-consuming or chaos build during the campaign, where the constant free casts matter most.

name: Cospri's Will
explicitStats: Curses you inflict have infinite Duration
Curses you inflict can affect Hexproof Enemies
Withered you inflict has infinite Duration
flavourText:
Curse their vile Council,
They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child.
If they only knew the power I possess.
description: (150-200)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield +(23-29)% to Chaos Resistance Curses you inflict have infinite Duration Curses you inflict can affect Hexproof Enemies Withered you inflict has infinite Duration

beginner.whatItIs: A high-level assassin garb with evasion, energy shield and chaos resistance that makes your curses and withers last forever and lets your curses affect enemies that are normally immune to them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Curse uptime and hexproof rare monsters are the two things that break a curse build, and this chest solves both at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: The centrepiece of a curse or wither build at level seventy-three and up. Nothing else in the slot compares if curses are your damage.

name: Couture of Crimson
explicitStats: (60-40)% reduced Duration of Bleeding on You
Life Leech can Overflow Maximum Life
flavourText: It's often said of nobles that they live off their peasants... sometimes, it's truer than any suspect.
description: (50-100)% increased Armour and Energy Shield (10-15)% increased maximum Life (60-40)% reduced Duration of Bleeding on You Life Leech can Overflow Maximum Life

beginner.whatItIs: A gilded vestment with armour, energy shield and increased maximum life that shortens bleeds on you and lets life leech carry you above your maximum life.
beginner.whyItMatters: Overflowing leech turns your normal healing into a buffer that sits on top of your health bar, which is extra effective health rather than just faster recovery.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a leech-heavy attack build at level fifty-two and up. Without strong leech the headline line never triggers.

name: Coward's Legacy
explicitStats: (30-40)% increased Life and Mana Recovery from Flasks
You are considered on Low Life while at 75% of maximum Life or below instead
flavourText:
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.
description: -(20-10) to Strength +(20-30) to Dexterity (30-40)% increased Life and Mana Recovery from Flasks You are considered on Low Life while at 75% of maximum Life or below instead

beginner.whatItIs: A mail belt that trades strength for dexterity, improves flask recovery, and makes you count as being on low life at seventy-five percent of your maximum instead of the usual threshold.
beginner.whyItMatters: It switches on every low-life bonus in your build while you are still at three quarters health, which is far safer than reaching that state the normal way.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a low-life build that wants the bonuses without the danger. On any other character it only makes you easier to kill through low-life monster effects.

name: Cracklecreep
explicitStats: Ignites you inflict spread to other Enemies that stay within 1.5 metres for 1 second
flavourText: Fear the fire that spreads like a plague.
description: (20-30)% increased Fire Damage (3.1-6) Life Regeneration per second (20-30)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Ignites you inflict spread to other Enemies that stay within 1.5 metres for 1 second

beginner.whatItIs: A ruby ring with fire resistance, fire damage and both life and mana regeneration whose ignites spread from a burning enemy to anything standing near it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Spreading ignite turns a single-target burn into pack clear, so an ignite build stops needing a separate area skill to handle crowds.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an ignite build from level eight onward. The spread needs enemies to stay close together for a second, so it works best in dense packs.

name: Crest of Ardura
flavourText:
When the Red Sekhema called,
the Ardura were the first to answer.
description: (60-100)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(10-20) to Intelligence (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate (30-50)% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate

beginner.whatItIs: A crest shield with armour, energy shield, intelligence, mana regeneration and a large increase to cooldown recovery rate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Cooldown recovery is what decides how often your strongest utility and movement skills come back, and it is rarely available on a shield at all.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For any build whose power is gated behind cooldowns rather than damage, from level twenty-eight.

name: Crown of Eyes
explicitStats: Increases and Reductions to Spell damage also apply to Attacks
flavourText:
Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.
description: (100-140)% increased Energy Shield +(150-200) to Accuracy Rating +(10-15) to all Attributes -10% to Fire Resistance Increases and Reductions to Spell damage also apply to Attacks

beginner.whatItIs: A circlet with energy shield, accuracy and all attributes that makes every increase to spell damage apply to your attacks as well, at the cost of some fire resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets an attack build harvest the spell damage passives and gear that would normally be useless to it, which can open up a whole second source of scaling.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an attack build with access to large spell damage bonuses, from level forty-five. It gives a caster nothing.

name: Crown of the Pale King
explicitStats: Thorns can Retaliate against all Hits
flavourText:
A lightless world
a silent reign
two sightless eyes
feed on your pain.
description: (50-100)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(40-80) to maximum Life 10% increased Rarity of Items found (10-15) to (20-25) Physical Thorns damage Thorns can Retaliate against all Hits

beginner.whatItIs: A cultist crown with armour, energy shield, life and item rarity that adds physical thorns damage and lets your thorns retaliate against every hit, not just melee ones.
beginner.whyItMatters: Thorns normally only answers attacks made in melee range, so allowing it to hit anything that damages you is what makes a thorns build viable against ranged enemies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: The enabling helmet for a thorns build from level sixteen. It is only a life and rarity piece on anything else.

name: Crown of the Victor
flavourText: An endless river of bodies lie in the wake of ambition.
description: (10-15)% increased Rarity of Items found Gain 10 Life per enemy killed Gain 10 Mana per enemy killed +1 to Level of all Skills

beginner.whatItIs: A low-level iron crown with item rarity that restores life and mana on each kill and adds a level to every skill you have.
beginner.whyItMatters: A universal skill level is a flat damage increase for every gem you own at once, and at level five that is a larger jump than any stat roll on the helmet slot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it from level five for as long as you can afford to give up defensive stats. It is one of the strongest early levelling helmets in the game.

name: Crown of Thorns
explicitStats: Lose 5 Life when you use a Skill
flavourText:
Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.
description: +(100-150) to maximum Energy Shield Lose 5 Life when you use a Skill (3-5) to (6-10) Physical Thorns damage Pain Attunement

beginner.whatItIs: A twig circlet with a large flat energy shield that costs five life every time you use a skill, adds physical thorns damage, and grants Pain Attunement.
beginner.whyItMatters: Pain Attunement is a large spell damage bonus that only applies while you are on low life, so the helmet both pushes you toward low life and rewards you for being there.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a low-life caster willing to manage the life cost per skill. On a full-life build the keystone is inactive and the life drain is pure downside.

name: Cruel Hegemony
implicitStats: Empowers the Map Boss of a Map
flavourText:
The lash of the whip,
the ire of the tithe...
the press of the boot.
description: Map Bosses have 1 additional Modifier

beginner.whatItIs: An overseer tablet that gives the map boss one extra modifier, with five uses.
beginner.whyItMatters: A stronger boss usually means better rewards, so the tablet is a deliberate difficulty trade rather than a free upgrade.
beginner.whenToUseIt: On maps whose boss you already beat comfortably. Applying it to a fight you are struggling with makes it worse for the same reward chance.

name: Cursecarver

randomModifierPool.placeholder: +4 to Level of (Random Curse) Skills
options: +4 to Level of Despair Skills
+4 to Level of Elemental Weakness Skills
+4 to Level of Enfeeble Skills
+4 to Level of Temporal Chains Skills
+4 to Level of Vulnerability Skills

flavourText: Lost in the Black Fen, Erian hoped that dawn would save him. He had no idea how far away the light truly was.
description: (80-100)% increased Spell Damage (10-20)% increased Cast Speed Lose 10 Life per enemy killed (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate +4 to Level of (Random Curse) Skills

beginner.whatItIs: An acrid wand with spell damage, cast speed and mana regeneration that grants four levels to one randomly chosen curse skill, and costs you life on every kill.
beginner.whyItMatters: Four levels on a curse is a large increase to its effect, but only for the curse it rolled, so which one you have is the whole item.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level thirty-three if the rolled curse is one your build already casts.

name: Daevata's Wind
implicitStats: (25-35)% increased Projectile Speed with this Weapon
explicitStats: (30-60)% increased Melee Damage if you've dealt a Projectile Attack Hit in the past eight seconds
(30-60)% increased Projectile Damage if you've dealt a Melee Hit in the past eight seconds
flavourText: As the flow of battle demanded, she became a sudden storm or a vanishing wind.
description: Adds (10-15) to (21-26) Physical Damage +100 to Evasion Rating (10-20)% increased Attack Speed (30-60)% increased Melee Damage if you've dealt a Projectile Attack Hit in the past eight seconds (30-60)% increased Projectile Damage if you've dealt a Melee Hit in the past eight seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A war spear with added physical damage, evasion and attack speed that raises your melee damage after a projectile hit, and your projectile damage after a melee hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards alternating between throwing and striking, so a build that does both keeps two bonuses running that a single-style build never sees.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level fifty-two spear build using both melee and projectile skills. Committing to one style turns half the weapon off.

name: Darkness Enthroned
explicitStats: (50-100)% increased effect of Socketed Augment Items
This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was (Random socketable equipment type)
