This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was Boots
This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was a Body Armour
This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was Gloves
This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was a Shield

flavourText:
Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crown.
Darkness coiled the world in eternal night.
Victory, a mere moment, came crashing down.
No conqueror, no conquered, only searing Light.
description: (50-100)% increased effect of Socketed Augment Items Has 2 Augment Sockets (Hidden) This item gains bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was (Random socketable equipment type)

beginner.whatItIs: A fine belt with two hidden augment sockets that greatly increases the effect of whatever you socket into it, and treats those sockets as though the belt were another piece of equipment entirely.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a multiplier rather than a stat stick, so its value is set completely by what you put into it and by which equipment type the belt rolled as.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Equip it once you own augments worth amplifying and the rolled equipment type matches them. Read that hidden line before committing your belt slot.

name: Darkray Vectors
explicitStats: 5% increased Movement Speed per Frenzy Charge
flavourText:
"Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster
than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness,
it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."
- Azmerian legend
description: (50-100)% increased Armour and Evasion +(20-30)% to Lightning Resistance 25% reduced Light Radius 5% increased Movement Speed per Frenzy Charge +1 to Maximum Frenzy Charges

beginner.whatItIs: Braced sabatons with armour, evasion and lightning resistance that raise your maximum frenzy charges and add movement speed for each charge you are holding.
beginner.whyItMatters: Frenzy charges are usually about attack speed, and these turn them into mobility as well, so a build that keeps them up moves noticeably faster all the time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on a build that generates frenzy charges. Without a generator both lines sit idle and the boots are only resistance.

name: Death Articulated
explicitStats: Lose 5% of maximum Life per second
flavourText:
"The mind at the center of the swarm... K'Tash does
the thinking... but it has only one thought... hate."
- Rantings of a Templar prisoner, page ninety-four
description: (100-150)% increased Armour and Evasion (5-10)% increased Attack Speed +(17-23)% to Chaos Resistance Lose 5% of maximum Life per second Regenerate 5 Rage per second No Inherent loss of Rage

beginner.whatItIs: Ornate gauntlets with armour, evasion, attack speed and chaos resistance that regenerate rage constantly, stop rage decaying, and drain five percent of your maximum life per second.
beginner.whyItMatters: Permanent full rage is a large ongoing damage bonus, and the life drain is a permanent cost, so the gloves demand that your recovery be solved before you put them on.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a rage build at level sixty-five with leech or heavy regeneration. Without recovery the drain alone will kill you between fights.

name: Death Rush
explicitStats: Leech 5% of Physical Attack Damage as Life
You gain Onslaught for 4 seconds on Kill
flavourText: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
description: +(75-125) to Accuracy Rating +(75-125) to Evasion Rating Leech 5% of Physical Attack Damage as Life You gain Onslaught for 4 seconds on Kill

beginner.whatItIs: An emerald ring with accuracy and evasion that leeches life from your physical attacks and grants Onslaught for a few seconds on every kill.
beginner.whyItMatters: Onslaught chains from kill to kill while clearing, so the ring keeps you fast and healing for as long as things keep dying.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a physical attack build from level twenty-six while clearing. In a single boss fight the Onslaught never triggers.

name: Death's Harp
implicitStats: +50% Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow
explicitStats: +(250-330)% Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow
flavourText:
The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.
description: +(20-25)% to Critical Damage Bonus Gain (20-30) Life per enemy killed Gain (12-18) Mana per enemy killed +(250-330)% Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow

beginner.whatItIs: A dualstring bow with critical damage that returns life and mana on every kill and carries a very large chance to fire an additional arrow.
beginner.whyItMatters: An extra arrow is close to a straight damage increase on a bow build, and the recovery on kill quietly solves sustain while you are clearing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a bow character from level twenty-eight, and it is strongest while clearing packs where the on-kill recovery keeps firing.

name: Deathblow
flavourText: Anticipation is a gift.
description: (100-150)% increased Armour and Evasion (5-10)% increased Attack Speed Gain (20-30) Life per enemy killed Gain (20-30) Mana per enemy killed Culling Strike

beginner.whatItIs: Doubled gauntlets with armour, evasion and attack speed that return life and mana on kill and grant Culling Strike.
beginner.whyItMatters: Culling Strike kills anything left below a tenth of its life outright, which removes the slowest part of a boss fight and makes the on-kill recovery fire sooner.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level thirty-three on almost any attack build, and it is especially good against high-life bosses where the last sliver takes longest.

name: Deathrattle
explicitStats: 20% chance for Energy Shield Recharge to start when you Kill an Enemy
flavourText: The cry of death whispers in the wind.
description: +(10-20) to maximum Energy Shield (20-40)% increased Spell Damage +(5-10) to Intelligence 20% chance for Energy Shield Recharge to start when you Kill an Enemy

beginner.whatItIs: A level one twig focus with energy shield, spell damage and intelligence that has a chance to start your shield recharge whenever you kill something.
beginner.whyItMatters: Restarting the recharge on kill means clearing a pack keeps your shield topped up, which is the recovery a starting caster otherwise has no access to.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a caster in the first acts. Its worth fades once you have real recharge rate or a shield large enough that one restart matters less.

name: Decree of Acuity
explicitStats: Gain (15-30)% of Evasion Rating as extra Armour
The Effect of Blind on you is reversed
flavourText:
"Focus. Hone your mind. Your lessers rely on the tangible.
Shed your senses, and raze them from this physical realm."
description: (150-250)% increased Armour and Evasion +(25-35) to Dexterity Gain (15-30)% of Evasion Rating as extra Armour You are Blind The Effect of Blind on you is reversed

beginner.whatItIs: An ancient visor with very high armour and evasion that grants extra armour equal to a share of your evasion rating, blinds you permanently, and reverses what blind does to you.
beginner.whyItMatters: The armour is added on top: your evasion rating is not reduced to pay for it. And reversed blind turns a permanent debuff into a permanent buff to your accuracy, so the helmet gives a benefit no ordinary piece can while looking like a penalty.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level sixty-five hybrid armour and evasion build. Anything that would remove blind from you also removes the bonus.

name: Decree of Flight
explicitStats: Gain Guard equal to (10-20)% of missing Energy Shield for 4 seconds when you Dodge Roll
Maximum amount of Guard is based on maximum Energy Shield instead
flavourText:
"Soar. Be swift. Let none trespass here, from
above or below, lest your purpose be forfeit."
description: 30% increased Movement Speed (150-200)% increased Armour and Energy Shield (20-30)% faster Dodge Roll Gain Guard equal to (10-20)% of missing Energy Shield for 4 seconds when you Dodge Roll Maximum amount of Guard is based on maximum Energy Shield instead Divine Flight

beginner.whatItIs: End-game ancient leggings with heavy movement speed and defences that grant Divine Flight, roll faster, and convert missing energy shield into a guard buff every time you dodge roll.
beginner.whyItMatters: Guard soaks the next hits outright, so rolling stops being only an evasive action and becomes an active shield you refresh whenever your energy shield is low.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level sixty-five energy shield character that rolls constantly. With a full shield the guard the roll grants is small.

name: Decree of Loyalty
explicitStats: Convert 1% of maximum Life to twice as much Armour per 1% Chaos Resistance above 0%
Defend with (150-200)% of Armour while you have Energy Shield
Damage over Time cannot bypass your Energy Shield
flavourText:
"Hold firm. Let no word but the Mothers' turn your head.
Through your unfaltering fealty, you achieve perfection."
description: (200-300)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(15-25) to Strength and Intelligence +(1-5)% to Maximum Chaos Resistance Convert 1% of maximum Life to twice as much Armour per 1% Chaos Resistance above 0% Defend with (150-200)% of Armour while you have Energy Shield Damage over Time cannot bypass your Energy Shield

beginner.whatItIs: An end-game ancient mail that raises your maximum chaos resistance, converts part of your life into armour based on how much chaos resistance you have, defends with far more of your armour while your energy shield is up, and stops damage over time bypassing that shield.
beginner.whyItMatters: It links chaos resistance to physical defence, so a stat that is normally just a tax on your gear turns into your armour value, and damage over time loses its usual free path past energy shield.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level seventy hybrid armour and energy shield character with chaos resistance stacked well above zero. Below zero chaos resistance the conversion gives you nothing.

name: Defiance of Destiny
explicitStats: Recover (20-30)% of Missing Life before being Hit by an Enemy
flavourText:
The respect of Karui warriors is hard to earn,
but lasts a lifetime... and beyond.
description: (6-10)% increased maximum Life +(10-20) to Strength (25-40)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Recover (20-30)% of Missing Life before being Hit by an Enemy

beginner.whatItIs: A jade amulet that raises your maximum life and mana regeneration, then heals back a fifth to a third of your missing life just before an enemy hit lands.
beginner.whyItMatters: The heal fires before the damage is applied, so the lower your life bar drops the larger the top-up gets, and single huge hits arrive against a much fuller bar than the one you were standing at.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it on a life-based character that takes occasional big hits rather than constant chip damage. It does very little for a build that dies to a stream of small attacks.

name: Deidbell
explicitStats: Warcries Explode Corpses dealing 10% of their Life as Physical Damage
Warcry Skills have (20-30)% increased Area of Effect
flavourText: May you never hear it toll.
description: (60-100)% increased Armour +(10-20) to Strength (20-30)% increased Warcry Speed Warcries Explode Corpses dealing 10% of their Life as Physical Damage Warcry Skills have (20-30)% increased Area of Effect

beginner.whatItIs: An elite greathelm with armour and strength that speeds up warcries, widens their area, and makes them explode nearby corpses for a share of their life as physical damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns a warcry from a buff into an attack, so a build that shouts regularly gets a wave of free area damage out of the bodies it already made.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a warcry build at level thirty-three clearing packs, where there are always corpses to detonate.

name: Demigod's Virtue
flavourText:
Those qualities possessed by the victor
are proven inherently right and true.
description: 25% increased Rarity of Items found Virtuous

beginner.whatItIs: A golden visage at level one with increased item rarity and the Virtuous keyword.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a prize item rather than a build piece, so its rarity bonus is the practical reason to wear it and the rest is presentation.
beginner.whenToUseIt: While farming at low level, or as a cosmetic choice. Replace it as soon as a helmet with real defences matters.

name: Demon Stitcher
explicitStats: Sacrifice (5-15)% of maximum Life to gain that much Energy Shield when you Cast a Spell
flavourText:
Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh,
until all that remained was a droplet of pure light:
The first Vaal.
description: +(40-60) to maximum Energy Shield +(80-120) to maximum Life (6-12)% increased Cast Speed Sacrifice (5-15)% of maximum Life to gain that much Energy Shield when you Cast a Spell

beginner.whatItIs: Intricate gloves with energy shield, life and cast speed that sacrifice a slice of your maximum life to grant that much energy shield every time you cast a spell.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts your life pool into shield on demand, so a caster can trade a resource it is not using for the defence it actually wants, one cast at a time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a caster at level thirty-three with a healthy life pool and a way to refill it. On a low-life build each cast is a real risk.

name: Dionadair
explicitStats: Double Stun Threshold while Shield is Raised
flavourText:
Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate
the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.
description: (60-80)% increased Armour +(10-15) to Strength (3-5) Life Regeneration per second 20% reduced Stun Threshold Double Stun Threshold while Shield is Raised

beginner.whatItIs: A splintered tower shield at level one with armour, strength and life regeneration that lowers your stun threshold but doubles it while the shield is raised.
beginner.whyItMatters: It punishes you for lowering your guard and protects you for keeping it up, which is a rule that teaches the shield mechanic while you level.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on a character that actually raises its shield. Playing without raising it leaves you easier to stun than before.

name: Doedre's Damning
explicitStats: You can apply an additional Curse
flavourText: Where her mouth should have been there was only a whirling, black void.
description: +(5-15)% to all Elemental Resistances Gain (1-10) Mana per enemy killed You can apply an additional Curse

beginner.whatItIs: A lazuli ring with mana, elemental resistance and mana on kill that lets you apply one more curse than normal.
beginner.whyItMatters: Curses are capped at one on most characters, so a second curse is a whole extra debuff on every enemy you fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on any curse build. A build that casts no curses gets only the resistance and mana.

name: Doedre's Tenure
flavourText:
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style,
she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
description: +(20-30) to maximum Energy Shield 100% increased Spell Damage (25-15)% reduced Cast Speed +(10-15) to Intelligence

beginner.whatItIs: Stitched gloves with energy shield and intelligence that double your spell damage and slow your casting noticeably.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a straight trade of speed for damage, so it favours a caster whose spells hit hard once over one that relies on casting quickly and repeatedly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on a slow, heavy-hitting spell build. It is a poor fit for anything that channels or spams a cheap spell.

name: Doomfletch
explicitStats: Attacks with this Weapon gain 100% of Physical damage as Extra damage of each Element
flavourText:
"Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch
description: Adds (5-7) to (10-12) Physical Damage +10 to Dexterity (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Attacks with this Weapon gain 100% of Physical damage as Extra damage of each Element

beginner.whatItIs: A composite bow with added physical damage and mana regeneration that adds your physical damage again as fire, cold and lightning damage on every attack.
beginner.whyItMatters: Every point of physical damage you add is counted four times over, so cheap physical rolls elsewhere on your gear become far more valuable than they look.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a physical bow build from level twenty-two that can also scale elemental damage. Its worth rises with every flat physical roll you stack.

name: Doomgate
explicitStats: You take (25-40)% of damage from Blocked Hits
flavourText: Welcome to Wraeclast.
description: (80-100)% increased Block chance (100-150)% increased Armour +(13-17)% to Chaos Resistance You take (25-40)% of damage from Blocked Hits Enemies are Culled on Block

beginner.whatItIs: A braced tower shield with a large block chance and armour bonus that culls enemies on a block, and lets part of the damage from a blocked hit through.
beginner.whyItMatters: Culling on block turns your defensive action into a kill, so blocking a weakened enemy finishes it rather than only stopping the hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twelve on a blocking build fighting many attackers. The partial damage through blocks is the price of the extra block chance.

name: Doryani's Prototype
explicitStats: +100% of Armour also applies to Lightning Damage
Enemies in your Presence have Lightning Resistance equal to yours
Lightning Resistance does not affect Lightning damage taken
flavourText:
"This was the first step in some grand design,
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher."
- Dominus, High Templar
description: (50-100)% increased Armour and Evasion +(60-100) to maximum Life +100% of Armour also applies to Lightning Damage Enemies in your Presence have Lightning Resistance equal to yours Lightning Resistance does not affect Lightning damage taken

beginner.whatItIs: A scale mail that makes your armour apply to lightning damage, sets enemies near you to your own lightning resistance, and stops lightning resistance from reducing the lightning damage you take.
beginner.whyItMatters: It swaps the usual way you handle lightning: instead of resisting it you soak it with armour, and any lightning resistance you stack becomes an offensive stat that protects your enemies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Build around it with heavy armour and deliberately low or negative lightning resistance. Wearing it with capped lightning resistance hands your enemies that same cap.

name: Double Vision
explicitStats: When you reload, triggers Gemini Surge to alternately gain (2-6) Cold Surges or (2-6) Fire Surges
flavourText:
For those without a home in the Vastiri, the
hot day is harsh, but the chill night is far worse.
description: Adds (14-21) to (25-37) Physical Damage +5% to Critical Hit Chance When you reload, triggers Gemini Surge to alternately gain (2-6) Cold Surges or (2-6) Fire Surges (15-25)% increased Reload Speed

beginner.whatItIs: A dyad crossbow that loads an extra bolt, adds physical damage and critical hit chance, and triggers Gemini Surge on reload to alternate between cold and fire surges.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reloading is dead time on most crossbows, and this pays you for it, so the rhythm of the weapon becomes part of your damage rather than a pause in it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a crossbow build from level twenty that can use both fire and cold surges. A single-element build gets half of the effect.

name: Dreadfist
flavourText: What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?
description: (60-100)% increased Armour (20-30)% increased Critical Damage Bonus Critical Hits inflict Impale Critical Hits cannot Extract Impale (20-31) to (31-49) Physical Thorns damage

beginner.whatItIs: Bolstered mitts with armour, critical damage and physical thorns whose critical hits inflict Impale that cannot be extracted.
beginner.whyItMatters: Impale makes an enemy take extra damage from later hits, and preventing extraction means the stacks stay on the target instead of being spent early.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a critical physical melee build at level twenty-seven fighting durable enemies. On trash that dies immediately impale never pays out.

name: Dream Fragments
explicitStats: You cannot be Chilled or Frozen
flavourText:
Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.
description: (10-15)% increased maximum Mana (30-50)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate You cannot be Chilled or Frozen

beginner.whatItIs: A sapphire ring with cold resistance, extra maximum mana and mana regeneration that makes you unable to be chilled or frozen.
beginner.whyItMatters: Freeze is a total loss of control rather than damage, and removing it entirely from one ring slot is worth more than the numbers around it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twelve in any cold content, and it stays relevant at every level because freeze never stops being dangerous.

name: Drillneck
explicitStats: Gain Deflection Rating equal to (24-32)% of Evasion Rating
Attack Projectiles Return if they Pierced at least (2-4) times
Projectiles deal (42-64)% increased Damage with Hits for each time they have Pierced
Projectiles have (42-64)% increased Critical Hit chance for each time they have Pierced
flavourText:
"Why waste such a fine arrow on just one man?"
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
description: +(60-90) to maximum Life (8-12)% increased Attack Speed Gain Deflection Rating equal to (24-32)% of Evasion Rating Attack Projectiles Return if they Pierced at least (2-4) times Projectiles deal (42-64)% increased Damage with Hits for each time they have Pierced Projectiles have (42-64)% increased Critical Hit chance for each time they have Pierced

beginner.whatItIs: A penetrating quiver with life and attack speed whose arrows always pierce, return after piercing several times, and gain large damage and critical chance for every pierce.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each enemy an arrow passes through makes the next hit stronger, so a shot fired into a line of monsters ends far more dangerous than it started.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a bow build at level fifty-five fighting groups in a line. Against a lone boss there is nothing to pierce and the bonuses never build.

name: Duality
explicitStats: Gain Finality for 0.5 seconds per Combo expended when using Skills
Gain (500-1000) Guard for 0.5 seconds per Combo expended when using Skills
flavourText:
Dannig saw Seren in his mind's eye, a public ornament of
extravagance. Until she bore Cadigan a son and vanished.
Decadence covering brutality, like all Kalguuran customs.
description: (200-300)% increased Physical Damage +(20-30)% to Critical Damage Bonus (12-22)% increased Attack Speed Gain Finality for 0.5 seconds per Combo expended when using Skills Gain (500-1000) Guard for 0.5 seconds per Combo expended when using Skills

beginner.whatItIs: A warding quarterstaff with very high physical damage and runic ward that grants Finality and a large amount of guard for each combo point you spend.
beginner.whyItMatters: Spending combo becomes a defensive act as well as an offensive one, so the moment you commit to a big attack is also the moment you are best protected.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level sixty-five combo-based quarterstaff build. Without combo generation neither of its two special lines fires.

name: Dunkelhalt
explicitStats: You take 50% of damage from Blocked Hits
flavourText:
"A thief in the night, Draven did creep,
families asleep, taken, held on high.
Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid.
Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."
description: (20-30)% increased Block chance +(20-30) to Evasion Rating You take 50% of damage from Blocked Hits 50% increased Parried Debuff Magnitude

beginner.whatItIs: A leather buckler available at level one that raises block chance and parry potency, and lets half the damage of a blocked hit through instead of stopping it entirely.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blocking more often but less completely spreads damage out into smaller pieces, which is easier to recover from than the occasional unblocked hit landing in full.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a parrying character in the opening acts. Give it up once you can find a buckler that blocks hits outright.

name: Dusk Vigil
explicitStats: Gain (30-50)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage
Trigger Ember Fusillade Skill on casting a Spell
flavourText: The candlemass tradition was born in a time of darkness and fear.
description: Gain (30-50)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage (80-120)% increased Spell Damage Gain (5-10) Life per enemy killed 25% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Trigger Ember Fusillade Skill on casting a Spell

beginner.whatItIs: A level one ashen staff with a large spell damage bonus that adds a slice of your damage as extra fire damage and triggers Ember Fusillade whenever you cast a spell.
beginner.whyItMatters: The triggered skill is free damage attached to something you were doing anyway, which is a large part of a starting caster's total output.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on any caster, and especially a fire one, through the opening acts.

name: Dustbloom
explicitStats: 0.5% of maximum Life Regenerated per second per Fragile Regrowth
10% increased Mana Regeneration Rate per Fragile Regrowth
Lose all Fragile Regrowth when Hit
flavourText:
Wraeclast has suffered many great disasters,
but life always springs back anew.
description: (100-150)% increased Evasion Rating +(20-30)% to Cold Resistance Maximum 10 Fragile Regrowth 0.5% of maximum Life Regenerated per second per Fragile Regrowth 10% increased Mana Regeneration Rate per Fragile Regrowth Lose all Fragile Regrowth when Hit Gain 1 Fragile Regrowth each second

beginner.whatItIs: A studded vest with evasion and cold resistance that stacks a buff called Fragile Regrowth once per second, up to ten, giving life and mana regeneration per stack, and loses every stack the moment you are hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: The recovery only exists while you are untouched, so the armour rewards avoiding hits entirely rather than surviving them, which fits how an evasion character wants to play anyway.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a dodge-heavy character from level twenty-six that spends fights out of reach. Against unavoidable area damage the stacks reset constantly and the vest is just evasion.

name: Earthbound
explicitStats: Trigger Spark Skill on killing a Shocked Enemy
flavourText: An ancient Azmeri staff, overgrown by roots...
description: (80-120)% increased Spell Damage (10-20)% increased Cast Speed (20-30)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Trigger Spark Skill on killing a Shocked Enemy (20-40)% increased chance to Shock

beginner.whatItIs: A level one voltaic staff with spell damage, cast speed and a higher shock chance that triggers Spark whenever you kill a shocked enemy.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shocking and killing are things a lightning caster already does, so the staff turns its own kills into a second wave of damage with no extra input.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on a lightning caster clearing packs, where the trigger chains from one kill to the next.

name: Edyrn's Tusks
explicitStats: 50% chance to inflict Bleeding on Hit
50% reduced Slowing Potency of Debuffs on You
flavourText:
In death, the legendary boar's tusks were turned
to the slaying of Phaaryl's Eternal oppressors.
description: (120-160)% increased Armour 50% chance to inflict Bleeding on Hit 50% reduced Slowing Potency of Debuffs on You (15-20) to (25-30) Physical Thorns damage

beginner.whatItIs: An early iron cuirass with heavy armour that bleeds enemies you hit, deals physical thorns damage back to attackers, and halves how much slows applied to you actually slow you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slows are what turn a survivable pack into a death, so cutting their potency keeps you moving in exactly the fights where a heavy armour character is most vulnerable.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a melee character in the early acts from level eleven, where the bleed and the thorns are a real share of your total damage.

name: Effigy of Cruelty
explicitStats: Critical Hits with Spells apply (1-3) Stacks of Critical Weakness
flavourText:
The horrors we imagined as children
still exist somewhere in the dark...
description: +(20-30) to maximum Energy Shield (40-50)% increased Spell Damage +10 to Intelligence +(7-13)% to Chaos Resistance Critical Hits with Spells apply (1-3) Stacks of Critical Weakness

beginner.whatItIs: An antler focus with energy shield, spell damage, intelligence and chaos resistance that stacks Critical Weakness on enemies when your spells critically hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each stack makes the target easier to critically hit again, so a critical caster's damage compounds within a single fight rather than staying flat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a critical spell build from level ten fighting durable targets. Against monsters that die instantly the stacks never accumulate.

name: Elevore
flavourText: Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
description: (50-80)% increased Evasion Rating +(20-30) to Dexterity Charms gain 1 charge per Second +(1-2) Charm Slots

beginner.whatItIs: A hunter hood with evasion and dexterity that adds one or two charm slots and refills your charms with a charge every second.
beginner.whyItMatters: Charms answer ailments automatically, so more of them plus constant recharge means a whole category of danger is handled without you doing anything.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level thirty-three in content that applies freezes, shocks, bleeds and ignites. It is one of the strongest defensive helmets for a character that keeps dying to ailments.

name: Empire's Grasp
flavourText:
"I like my vassals at sword point,
but my enemies as close as the hilt."
- Emperor Chitus
description: (150-200)% increased Armour +(20-30) to Strength Gain (30-50) Life per enemy killed (10-20)% increased Global Physical Damage Knockback direction is reversed

beginner.whatItIs: Titan mitts with heavy armour, strength, physical damage and life on kill whose special line reverses the direction of your knockback.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reversed knockback pulls enemies towards you instead of away, which turns a mechanic that normally scatters a pack into one that gathers it up for a melee hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a melee build at level fifty-two with a knockback source. Without knockback the reversal line does nothing at all.

name: Enezun's Charge
explicitStats: (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance for Spells
25% chance to not destroy Corpses when Consuming Corpses
flavourText: He alone was welcome in the sacred spaces of the Titans.
description: (80-100)% increased Spell Damage (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance for Spells Gain (10-15) Mana per enemy killed 25% chance to not destroy Corpses when Consuming Corpses

beginner.whatItIs: A volatile wand with spell damage, spell critical chance and mana on kill that sometimes leaves a corpse intact after you consume it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Corpses are a limited resource for skills that eat them, so keeping a quarter of them means noticeably more casts out of the same bodies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on a build that consumes corpses. On anything else the special line does nothing.

name: Enfolding Dawn
explicitStats: Gain no inherent bonus from Intelligence
flavourText: The gleam of the night and the howling teeth alike could not abate the rising of the sun.
description: (50-100)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +100 to Spirit +(5-15)% to all Elemental Resistances Gain no inherent bonus from Intelligence

beginner.whatItIs: A level one robe with armour, energy shield, resistances and a flat hundred spirit, whose cost is that intelligence stops granting you its usual bonus.
beginner.whyItMatters: A hundred spirit at level one pays for buffs or minions a starting character normally cannot afford for another thirty levels, which changes what your build can do immediately.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it on a character that does not lean on intelligence for its defences. On an energy shield caster, losing the intelligence bonus takes back most of what the robe gives.

name: Erian's Cobble
flavourText:
Sometimes patching up your
equipment gets out of hand.
description: +(0-40) to Armour +(0-30) to Evasion Rating +(0-20) to maximum Energy Shield +(0-60) to Accuracy Rating +(0-30) to maximum Life +(0-20) to maximum Mana (0-20)% increased Rarity of Items found (0-30)% increased Critical Hit Chance +(0-10) to Strength +(0-10) to Dexterity +(0-10) to Intelligence +(0-10)% to Fire Resistance +(0-10)% to Cold Resistance +(0-10)% to Lightning Resistance (0-6) Life Regeneration per second

beginner.whatItIs: A guarded helm whose fifteen modifiers all roll from zero upwards, covering defences, attributes, resistances, life, mana, rarity and critical chance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Every line can roll at nothing, so the helmet ranges from a blank slot to a genuinely broad piece, and the roll is the entire item.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level eleven, and only with a good spread of rolls. Read all fifteen lines before deciding it is worth the slot.

name: Eshtera's Path
explicitStats: You can only Socket Sapphire Jewels in this item
+(5-10)% to Fire and Cold Resistances per Equipped Item with a Lightning Resistance Modifier
flavourText:
Though the Winter of the World shrouded the
Vastiri in ice, we remained, unchanged.
description: Has 1 Jewel Socket (Hidden) You can only Socket Sapphire Jewels in this item (10-20)% increased Rarity of Items found +(10-20) to all Attributes +(5-10)% to Fire and Cold Resistances per Equipped Item with a Lightning Resistance Modifier

beginner.whatItIs: A ring with a hidden jewel socket that only accepts sapphire jewels, plus attributes, item rarity and fire and cold resistance for each item you wear carrying a lightning resistance modifier.
beginner.whyItMatters: It pays you for how your other gear is rolled, so its value is decided by your whole equipment set rather than by the ring itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level forty when several of your items already carry lightning resistance and you own a sapphire jewel worth socketing.

name: Essentia Sanguis
explicitStats: Adds 1 to (30-50) Lightning damage to Attacks
Life Leech is Converted to Energy Shield Leech
flavourText:
The darkest clouds clashed and coupled,
giving birth to four lightning children of hate.
description: (50-70)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield Adds 1 to (30-50) Lightning damage to Attacks +(15-25) to Intelligence +(25-35)% to Lightning Resistance Life Leech is Converted to Energy Shield Leech

beginner.whatItIs: Furtive wraps with evasion, energy shield, intelligence and added lightning damage that convert your life leech into energy shield leech.
beginner.whyItMatters: Leech refills you as you deal damage and is normally locked to life, so redirecting it into energy shield hands a shield character a recovery tool it has no other way to buy.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an energy shield attack build at level fifty-two that already leeches. On a life build the conversion takes away your healing.

name: Eventide Petals
explicitStats: Ice Crystals have (-3-3)% increased maximum Life per 5% Cold Resistance you have
flavourText:
Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the
night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks,
which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
description: (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance +(25-35) to Intelligence (30-50)% increased Light Radius Ice Crystals have (-3-3)% increased maximum Life per 5% Cold Resistance you have

beginner.whatItIs: A veridical chain giving runic ward, critical hit chance, intelligence and light radius, plus a line that scales the life of your Ice Crystals with your own cold resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Ice Crystals normally shatter to a stray hit, so tying their durability to a stat you were already capping keeps them alive long enough to actually do their job.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only pick it up if you run a skill that creates Ice Crystals. Check the roll: the crystal line can roll negative, in which case the amulet works against you.

name: Evergrasping Ring
explicitStats: Allies in your Presence Gain (15-25)% of Damage as Extra Chaos Damage
Enemies in your Presence Gain (6-12)% of Damage as Extra Chaos Damage
flavourText:
Power comes to those who seek
Death comes to those who reach
description: +(60-100) to maximum Mana Allies in your Presence Gain (15-25)% of Damage as Extra Chaos Damage Enemies in your Presence Gain (6-12)% of Damage as Extra Chaos Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A pearl ring with cast speed and mana that gives allies near you a large slice of their damage as extra chaos damage, and gives enemies near you a smaller slice of the same.
beginner.whyItMatters: It buffs both sides of the fight, so it is only worth wearing when the allies standing next to you outnumber and outdamage what you are fighting.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For group play from level thirty-two. Alone, you are buffing enemies and nobody else.

name: Eye of Chayula
flavourText: Never blinking, always watching.
description: (30-20)% reduced maximum Life +(10-15) to all Attributes Cannot be Light Stunned

beginner.whatItIs: A gold amulet that cuts a fifth to a third of your maximum life, hands back attributes and item rarity, and makes you immune to light stuns.
beginner.whyItMatters: Light stuns are the small interruptions that break a channel or cancel a cast at the worst moment, and removing them entirely changes how safely you can commit to a long animation.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a character whose survival does not lean on the life pool, such as an energy shield caster. On a life build the missing life is a steep price for stun immunity.

name: Eyes of the Runefather
explicitStats: Inflicts Runefather's Challenge on enemies 6 metres in front of you when raised, no more than once every 2 seconds
Gain 1 Runefather's Boast per Power of targets affected by Runefather's Challenge you kill
flavourText:
From aeons past, Dannig felt the Runefather's
gaze, challenging him. There is no honour in ease.
True greatness is torn from the jaws of defeat.
description: (300-400)% increased Armour and Evasion +(40-50)% to Cold Resistance Off-hand Hits inflict Runefather's Challenge Inflicts Runefather's Challenge on enemies 6 metres in front of you when raised, no more than once every 2 seconds Gain 1 Runefather's Boast per Power of targets affected by Runefather's Challenge you kill

beginner.whatItIs: A venerable defender with very high armour and evasion that inflicts Runefather's Challenge on enemies in front of you when raised, and builds Runefather's Boast as you kill challenged targets.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards a shield that is actively held up rather than carried, so the defensive stance becomes the way you build an offensive stack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level sixty-two blocking build that fights facing forwards and kills what it has marked.

name: Ezomyte Peak
flavourText:
Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.
description: (50-100)% increased Armour +(50-80) to maximum Life (3-6) Life Regeneration per second (10-20)% increased Area of Effect Unwavering Stance

beginner.whatItIs: A soldier greathelm with armour, life, life regeneration and a wider area of effect that grants Unwavering Stance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Unwavering Stance makes you unable to be stunned, which removes the interruption that kills slow melee characters in the campaign.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twelve on a melee build getting stun-locked. Note that it also stops you dodging in the ways stun avoidance normally allows.

name: Facebreaker
explicitStats: Has 8 to 12 Physical damage, +3 to +4 per Boss's Face Broken
+0.3 metres to Melee Strike Range while Unarmed
Can Attack as though using a One Handed Mace while both of your hand slots are empty
Unarmed Attacks that would use an Equipped One Hand Mace's damage use this Item's damage
flavourText:
"You think us savages?" Mused the Red Wolf, as
he pulled teeth from the Eternal's skull. "I will
show your kind the way of tooth and claw."
description: Has 8 to 12 Physical damage, +3 to +4 per Boss's Face Broken (30-50)% increased Stun Buildup 1% more Unarmed Damage per 5 Strength +0.3 metres to Melee Strike Range while Unarmed +1 to Armour per Strength Can Attack as though using a One Handed Mace while both of your hand slots are empty Unarmed Attacks that would use an Equipped One Hand Mace's damage use this Item's damage

beginner.whatItIs: Level one stocky mitts built for fighting with no weapon at all: they set your unarmed damage, extend your unarmed strike range, add armour per point of strength, and let you attack as though holding a one-handed mace with empty hands.
beginner.whyItMatters: They make an unarmed character viable, which is not otherwise a build, and every point of strength you stack raises both your damage and your armour.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a deliberately unarmed strength build from level one. Equipping any weapon turns off the entire item.

name: Fairgraves' Curse
explicitStats: Attack Hits inflict Spectral Fire for 8 seconds
flavourText:
The power of the Allflame rends
souls just as easily as flesh.
description: Adds (76-98) to (126-193) Fire Damage (30-50)% increased Flammability Magnitude (10-20)% increased Ignite Magnitude 30% reduced Life Recovery rate -30 Physical Damage taken from Hits Attack Hits inflict Spectral Fire for 8 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: An artillery bow with huge added fire damage that inflicts Spectral Fire on hit, deepens flammability and ignite, and cuts your projectile range in half.
beginner.whyItMatters: Halved range means you fight much closer than a bow user normally does, so the fire damage has to make up for standing where a bow build is least comfortable.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a fire bow build at level forty-five willing to play at short range. The flat reduction to physical damage taken helps make that distance survivable.

name: Feathered Fortress
explicitStats: No Movement Speed Penalty while Shield is Raised
flavourText: Ride the western wind, and take flight.
description: +(20-30) to Strength +(20-30) to Dexterity +(20-30)% to Fire Resistance +(20-30)% to Cold Resistance No Movement Speed Penalty while Shield is Raised

beginner.whatItIs: A crescent targe with attributes and heavy fire and cold resistance that removes the movement penalty you normally take while your shield is raised.
beginner.whyItMatters: Raising a shield usually means giving up mobility, and removing that lets you stay guarded while repositioning instead of choosing between the two.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twenty-six on any build that holds its shield up, and it is at its best in fights that force constant movement.

name: Fireflower
explicitStats: Take 100 Fire Damage when you Ignite an Enemy
+(1-4) to Level of all Fire Skills
flavourText:
Tale-women in training drink of a painful desert fruit.
Fire, they learn, springs from agony.
description: (10-15)% increased Rarity of Items found (30-40)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Take 100 Fire Damage when you Ignite an Enemy +(1-4) to Level of all Fire Skills

beginner.whatItIs: A solar amulet granting spirit, item rarity and mana regeneration alongside up to four levels on every fire skill, in exchange for taking a hundred fire damage each time you ignite something.
beginner.whyItMatters: Levels on fire skills raise base damage on every hit rather than adding a percentage, so the amulet is a real power step for a fire build, but the self-damage scales with how often you ignite.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Suits a fire build that ignites in bursts against tough targets. It is dangerous on a fast clear build that ignites a screen of monsters at once, and worse still if your fire resistance is not capped.

name: Fixation of Yix
explicitStats: Allies in your Presence have (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance
Allies in your Presence have (30-50)% increased Critical Damage Bonus
Allies in your Presence have (10-20)% increased Attack Speed
Allies in your Presence have (10-20)% increased Cast Speed
flavourText:
He knew not why he was changing, only
that he wanted to hold his family close...
description: +100 to maximum Life Allies in your Presence have (30-50)% increased Critical Hit Chance Allies in your Presence have (30-50)% increased Critical Damage Bonus Allies in your Presence have (10-20)% increased Attack Speed Allies in your Presence have (10-20)% increased Cast Speed 50% reduced Presence Area of Effect

beginner.whatItIs: A stellar amulet that gives you flat life and attributes while handing every ally standing in your presence extra critical chance, critical damage, attack speed and cast speed, at the cost of halving how far your presence reaches.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns your character into a damage aura for the people next to you, which is worth far more than what the amulet gives you personally.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Group play only, and only if your party fights close together. The halved presence radius means someone who wanders off gets none of it, and playing alone gets you a life and attribute amulet.

name: Flesh Crucible

randomModifierPool.placeholder: (Random stat penalty)
options: (20-10)% less Damage
(20-10)% less Defences
(20-10)% less maximum Life
(20-10)% less maximum Mana
(20-10)% less Movement Speed
(20-10)% less Spirit

flavourText:
"Never mind the pain, it's only... making room. Unrelated fact,
a person can live a normal life with just one kidney. Or just one
lung. You never know what Vaal technology will cost you..."
description: (Keystone Passive Skill) (Random stat penalty)

beginner.whatItIs: A diamond jewel that grants a keystone passive skill and charges you a random penalty to damage, defences, life, mana, movement speed or spirit.
beginner.whyItMatters: A keystone from a jewel socket saves the long passive path you would otherwise walk to reach it, and the penalty decides whether that shortcut is affordable.
beginner.whenToUseIt: When the keystone it rolled is one your build wanted and the penalty lands on a stat you can spare. Read both lines together, never just the keystone.

name: Font of Power
explicitStats: When a Party Member in your Presence Casts a Spell, you
Sacrifice 20% of Mana and they Leech that Mana
flavourText:
Tale-women may not fight directly,
for they have a much higher purpose.
description: (30-50)% increased Spirit +(40-60) to maximum Mana (20-30)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate When a Party Member in your Presence Casts a Spell, you Sacrifice 20% of Mana and they Leech that Mana

beginner.whatItIs: An omen sceptre with mana, spirit and mana regeneration that sacrifices a fifth of your mana whenever a party member near you casts a spell, letting them leech that mana.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes your mana pool the party's mana pool, so a supporting character can keep a caster casting far longer than that caster could alone.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For group play from level sixteen on a support character with mana to give. Alone, the sacrifice line never triggers.

name: For Utopia
explicitStats: Defend with 200% of Armour during effect
flavourText:
"It may be centuries hence, but I still hold utmost faith.
The Savior will rise, and mankind will be free."
description: Defend with 200% of Armour during effect

beginner.whatItIs: A stone charm that triggers when you are stunned and makes you defend with twice your armour value for its duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being stunned is exactly when you cannot act and are about to be hit again, so the charm answers the most dangerous moment automatically without you pressing anything.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an armoured character from level eight fighting enemies that stun. On a low-armour build there is little for the effect to multiply.

name: Forgotten Warden
explicitStats: +(70-100) to Deflection Rating per 50 missing Energy Shield
(10-15)% of Damage from Deflected Hits is taken from Damageable Companion's Life before you
flavourText:
A gift from the Draíocht, lost in Darkness.
The bronze hums. The cloth sighs.
Living pieces of her, yearning to exist.
description: +(70-100) to Deflection Rating per 50 missing Energy Shield (200-300)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield +(20-30) to Dexterity Companions have (30-50)% increased maximum Life (10-15)% of Damage from Deflected Hits is taken from Damageable Companion's Life before you

beginner.whatItIs: End-game primal markings that convert missing energy shield into deflection rating, give your companions much more life, and push part of the damage from deflected hits onto a companion instead of you.
beginner.whyItMatters: It inverts the usual rule that a damaged shield is a problem: the emptier your shield, the harder you are to hit cleanly, and your companion absorbs part of what still lands.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a companion build at level seventy that expects its shield to sit low in a fight. With a full shield the deflection line is close to nothing.

name: Forsaken Bangle
implicitStats: Used when you take Chaos damage from a Hit
explicitStats: 50% of Chaos damage you prevent when Hit Recouped as Life and Mana during effect
flavourText:
Among the Templars, a secret few ate the sins of others.
They bore this burden to empower their hidden Order.
description: (15-25)% increased Duration 50% of Chaos damage you prevent when Hit Recouped as Life and Mana during effect

beginner.whatItIs: An amethyst charm that triggers on chaos damage and pays back half the chaos damage you prevented as both life and mana while it is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chaos damage usually goes straight past energy shield and is the hardest to recover from, so getting recovery out of it turns a punishing damage type into a resource.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For chaos-heavy content from level forty on a character with real chaos resistance. With no resistance there is little prevented damage to pay back.

name: Foxshade
explicitStats: 10% increased Movement Speed when on Full Life
100% increased Evasion Rating when on Full Life
flavourText: To catch an animal, think like an animal.
description: +(50-70) to Evasion Rating +(20-30) to Dexterity 10% increased Movement Speed when on Full Life 100% increased Evasion Rating when on Full Life

beginner.whatItIs: A very early quilted vest with dexterity and evasion that adds movement speed and doubles your evasion rating while your life bar is completely full.
beginner.whyItMatters: It pays out only when you are untouched, so it makes the first hit you take expensive and rewards a player who kills packs before they reach them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a ranged or evasion character in the first acts from level four. Any build that takes constant chip damage will rarely see the bonus at all.

name: Freedom of Faith
implicitStats: Adds Ritual Altars to a Map
explicitStats: Favours at Ritual Altars in Area costs (10-15)% increased Tribute
Can Reroll Favours at Ritual Altars in your Maps twice as many times
flavourText:
When darkness comes, we pray for light.
When darkness is all that there is,
we pray for death.
description: Favours at Ritual Altars in Area costs (10-15)% increased Tribute Can Reroll Favours at Ritual Altars in your Maps twice as many times

beginner.whatItIs: A ritual tablet that adds ritual altars to a map, raises the tribute cost of favours there, and lets you reroll the altar offerings twice as many times.
beginner.whyItMatters: More rerolls means far better odds of finding the item you actually wanted, paid for by each favour costing more tribute.
beginner.whenToUseIt: When you are hunting a specific ritual reward rather than farming tribute efficiently.

name: From Nothing
explicitStats: Passives in Radius of (Keystone) can be Allocated without being connected to your tree
flavourText:
They clawed their way up from the agonising depths of nonexistence,
breathing deep with joy the exquisite light of meaning.
description: Passives in Radius of (Keystone) can be Allocated without being connected to your tree

beginner.whatItIs: A diamond jewel that lets passives around a keystone in its radius be allocated without connecting them to the rest of your tree.
beginner.whyItMatters: Passives normally have to be reached by a connected path, so this cuts out every filler point on the way and turns a distant cluster into a direct purchase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: When the cluster it reaches is worth more than the points you would have spent travelling. Its value depends entirely on where you can socket it.

name: Frostbreath
explicitStats: All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Freeze Buildup
flavourText:
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.
description: Adds (8-12) to (16-20) Physical Damage Adds (8-12) to (16-20) Cold Damage +5% to Critical Hit Chance All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Freeze Buildup Culling Strike against Frozen Enemies

beginner.whatItIs: A slim mace with added physical and cold damage where all of its hit damage builds freeze, and which culls frozen enemies outright.
beginner.whyItMatters: Freezing and then culling means the mace ends fights early on anything it can lock down, which is a large advantage in the campaign.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level ten on a melee build against enemies that can be frozen. Bosses resist freeze heavily, so it is a clearing weapon.

name: Fury of the King
implicitStats: 30% of this Weapon's base Physical Damage Converted to Fire Damage (Hidden)
explicitStats: Bear Skills Convert 80% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage
Skills which require Glory generate (2-5) Glory every 2 seconds
Enemies in your Presence have Exposure
flavourText:
Gruthkul was the Mother of Despair...
but one day, the Father will return,
and discover the fate of his children.
description: Adds (503-589) to (647-713) Fire Damage (20-15)% reduced Attack Speed +(30-40) to Strength Bear Skills Convert 80% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage Skills which require Glory generate (2-5) Glory every 2 seconds Enemies in your Presence have Exposure

beginner.whatItIs: An ashbark talisman with an enormous added fire damage roll that converts most bear skill damage to fire, generates Glory over time, and applies exposure to enemies near you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Automatic Glory generation means a skill that normally waits on a resource can be used on cooldown instead of being rationed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level seventy-two fire shapeshifting build using bear skills and Glory. On anything else most of the talisman is inert.

name: Gamblesprint
explicitStats: Gain 0% to 40% increased Movement Speed at random when Hit, until Hit again
flavourText:
All your tomorrows lie ahead of you,
unknown and snarled to the very last.
description: (100-140)% increased Evasion Rating (10-15)% increased Rarity of Items found +(10-15) to Dexterity +(15-25)% to Lightning Resistance Gain 0% to 40% increased Movement Speed at random when Hit, until Hit again

beginner.whatItIs: Embossed boots with evasion, dexterity, lightning resistance and item rarity that reroll a random movement speed bonus, anywhere from nothing to forty percent, each time you are hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Your speed is decided by chance rather than by you, so the boots are exciting rather than dependable and cannot be planned around in a fight where positioning matters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For casual clearing at level sixteen where the average is good enough. Avoid them in content where a bad roll at the wrong moment gets you killed.

name: Geofri's Sanctuary
explicitStats: (150-200)% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield
Your maximum Energy Shield is equal to (200-300)% of your Strength
Maximum Energy Shield cannot be Converted
Regenerate 2 Life per second for every 10 Intelligence
flavourText:
Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.
description: (150-200)% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield +(10-20)% to all Elemental Resistances Your maximum Energy Shield is equal to (200-300)% of your Strength Maximum Energy Shield cannot be Converted Regenerate 2 Life per second for every 10 Intelligence Zealot's Oath

beginner.whatItIs: A late revered vestment that sets your maximum energy shield to a multiple of your strength, raises your maximum elemental resistances, regenerates life from intelligence, and grants Zealot's Oath.
beginner.whyItMatters: It moves energy shield off intelligence and onto strength, so a heavily armoured character can carry a real shield pool for the first time, and Zealot's Oath sends your life regeneration into that shield.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a strength-stacking character at level sixty-five. On a build with modest strength the shield pool it sets will be smaller than the one it replaces.

name: Ghostmarch
flavourText:
The cursed ones march forever,
On their hopeless, last endeavour.
description: (100-150)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield +(30-50) to maximum Mana +(17-23)% to Chaos Resistance Dodge Roll passes through Enemies 15% increased Movement Speed

beginner.whatItIs: Threaded shoes with evasion, energy shield, mana and chaos resistance that let your dodge roll pass straight through enemies and add movement speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being blocked by a monster body is what makes a dodge roll fail in a crowd, and removing that turns the roll into a reliable escape rather than a gamble.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on any character that fights in packs. It is one of the biggest quality-of-life upgrades available on a boots slot.

name: Ghostwrithe
explicitStats: 35% of Maximum Life Converted to Energy Shield
flavourText: Faith Springs Abundant at the edge of Death
description: +100 to maximum Energy Shield +(29-37)% to Chaos Resistance 35% of Maximum Life Converted to Energy Shield

beginner.whatItIs: A level one tattered robe with flat energy shield and heavy chaos resistance that converts a third of your maximum life into energy shield.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns a life pool into a shield pool this early, which gives a starting caster the shield it has no other way to buy and hands it chaos resistance at the same time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it from level one on a caster that wants to be shield-based. It is a poor idea on a build whose recovery, leech or regeneration is tied to life.

name: Gifts from Above
explicitStats: (20-30)% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Enemies killed with a Critical Hit
You have Consecrated Ground around you while stationary
flavourText: God blesses those who bless themselves.
description: (20-30)% increased Critical Hit Chance (20-30)% increased Light Radius (20-30)% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Enemies killed with a Critical Hit You have Consecrated Ground around you while stationary

beginner.whatItIs: A prismatic ring with elemental resistance, critical hit chance and a wider light radius that creates consecrated ground under you while you stand still, and improves loot from enemies killed by a critical hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Consecrated ground heals and steadies you where you are standing, so a critical build that fights from a position gets recovery and better drops from the same ring.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level thirty-five on a stationary critical build, especially while farming.

name: Glimpse of Chaos
flavourText:
Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation
only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
description: Can be modified while Corrupted +(50-150) to maximum Life +(50-150) to maximum Mana +(-30-30)% to Fire Resistance +(-30-30)% to Cold Resistance +(-30-30)% to Lightning Resistance Chaos Resistance is zero

beginner.whatItIs: A tribal mask with large life and mana rolls, elemental resistances that can roll anywhere from minus thirty to plus thirty, chaos resistance forced to zero, and the ability to be modified even while corrupted.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being modifiable while corrupted is a rule no ordinary item has, so the mask is a crafting platform as much as a helmet, and its resistance rolls decide whether it is a gift or a trap.
beginner.whenToUseIt: At level fifty-two for a character that can cover zero chaos resistance elsewhere and has the currency to craft on it.

name: Gloamgown
explicitStats: Your base Energy Shield Recharge Delay is 10 seconds
flavourText: The tale-women of old knew how to build anticipation.
description: (100-140)% increased Energy Shield +(30-40) to Spirit +(25-35)% to Cold Resistance 1000% increased Energy Shield Recharge Rate Your base Energy Shield Recharge Delay is 10 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: An elementalist robe with spirit and cold resistance that raises your energy shield recharge rate enormously but sets the delay before that recharge starts to a full ten seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It trades frequency for speed: the shield comes back almost instantly once it begins, but you have to survive ten untouched seconds to get there.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a build that can break contact between fights and does not expect sustained pressure. In dense or ranged-heavy content the delay never finishes.

name: Gloomform
explicitStats: You have a Smoke Cloud around you while stationary
flavourText:
It was in this forsaken land, where mists shroud the world in mystery,
that thieves, murderers, and outcasts, sought refuge.
description: (100-150)% increased Evasion Rating +(10-20) to Dexterity +(10-20)% to Fire Resistance 20% reduced Light Radius You have a Smoke Cloud around you while stationary

beginner.whatItIs: An early waxed jacket with evasion, dexterity and fire resistance that surrounds you with a smoke cloud whenever you stand still, at the cost of a dimmer light radius.
beginner.whyItMatters: The smoke cloud blinds what comes into it, so standing to cast or to channel becomes a defensive act instead of a risk, which is unusual on a piece this cheap.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level eleven on a character that fights from a fixed position. It gives nothing to a build that is constantly moving.

name: Glowswarm
explicitStats: Mana Flasks gain (0.17-0.25) charges per Second
Using a Mana Flask grants Guard equal to 100% of Flask's recovery amount for 4 seconds
flavourText:
As their eyes adjusted, they became aware of a strange
blue light. Countless glowing worms crawled above,
blissfully unaware of their flight from the sirens.
description: +(40-60) to maximum Mana (20-30)% increased Flask Mana Recovery rate Mana Flasks gain (0.17-0.25) charges per Second Using a Mana Flask grants Guard equal to 100% of Flask's recovery amount for 4 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A lazuli ring with maximum mana and faster mana flask recovery whose special line grants guard equal to your flask's whole recovery amount when you drink it.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns a mana flask into a defensive cooldown, so the button you were already pressing to keep casting also absorbs the next hits you take.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on a caster that drinks mana flasks regularly. With no mana flask equipped the guard line does nothing.

name: Goldrim
flavourText: No metal slips as easily through the fingers as gold.
description: +(30-50) to Evasion Rating 10% increased Rarity of Items found +(25-35)% to all Elemental Resistances

beginner.whatItIs: A felt cap with evasion and item rarity that gives a very large bonus to all three elemental resistances.
beginner.whyItMatters: Resistance is the main thing keeping a levelling character alive, and this covers all three at once from a single early slot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear it through the campaign from level ten. It is often the piece that lets a new character skip resistance entirely on the rest of its gear.

name: Goregirdle
flavourText: Bleeding just means you're still alive.
description: +(20-30) to Strength (10-20) Life Regeneration per second Defend with 200% of Armour Maximum Physical Damage Reduction is 50%

beginner.whatItIs: A plate belt with strength, heavy life regeneration and extra armour that makes you defend with two hundred percent of your armour, while capping physical damage reduction at fifty percent.
beginner.whyItMatters: Counting your armour at two hundred percent is a large defensive step for a heavily armoured character, and the reduction cap is a ceiling most builds never reach anyway.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an armour-stacking character from level twenty-five. It gives almost nothing to an evasion or energy shield build with little armour to double.

name: Grand Spectrum
explicitStats: 2% increased Spirit per socketed Grand Spectrum
flavourText: An indomitable force of control.
description: 2% increased Spirit per socketed Grand Spectrum

variants.name: Grand Spectrum (Ruby)
variants.label: Ruby
explicitStats: 2% increased Maximum Life per socketed Grand Spectrum

variants.name: Grand Spectrum (Sapphire)
variants.label: Sapphire
explicitStats: +6% to all Elemental Resistances per socketed Grand Spectrum

beginner.whatItIs: An emerald jewel that increases your spirit by a small amount for every Grand Spectrum you have socketed, including itself.
beginner.whyItMatters: The bonus counts all copies, so each additional one is worth more than the last and a single jewel on its own is nearly pointless.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only in groups of three or more, on a build that wants spirit for auras or minions.

name: Gravebind
explicitStats: Enemies in your Presence killed by anyone count as being killed by you instead
Your other Modifiers to Rarity of Items found do not apply
flavourText:
Try as you like to hide the
blood on your hands.
You'll still know the truth.
description: (40-60)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(10-15)% to Cold Resistance Gain (7-10) Life per enemy killed Gain (4-6) Mana per enemy killed Enemies in your Presence killed by anyone count as being killed by you instead 20% increased Rarity of Items found Your other Modifiers to Rarity of Items found do not apply

beginner.whatItIs: Rope cuffs with armour, energy shield and cold resistance that count enemies killed by anyone near you as your own kills, and set your item rarity to a fixed twenty percent that overrides other rarity bonuses.
beginner.whyItMatters: Crediting you with a companion's or party member's kills makes every on-kill effect you own fire far more often, which is what the gloves are really for.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a build with strong on-kill effects and minions, companions or party members doing the killing. The fixed rarity is a loss if you already stack rarity.

name: Greed's Embrace
flavourText:
Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.
description: 50% increased Strength Requirement 20% reduced Movement Speed (100-150)% increased Armour (30-50)% increased Rarity of Items found +(20-30)% to Fire Resistance

beginner.whatItIs: A vaal cuirass with heavy armour, fire resistance and a large item rarity bonus, paid for with much steeper strength requirements and a fifth of your movement speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Rarity on a chest slot is rare, and this puts a farming stat on a piece that is normally pure defence, so the slot does two jobs at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For farming content you already clear safely at level thirty-seven. The movement penalty is severe, so swap it out before anything that demands repositioning.

name: Greymake
flavourText: In the end, even heroes fade away.
description: +(30-50) to Strength +(30-50) to Dexterity +(30-50) to Intelligence -1 to all Attributes per Level Has 4 Augment Sockets (Hidden)

beginner.whatItIs: A brimmed helm with four hidden augment sockets that grants a large chunk of every attribute and then takes one point of each away per character level.
beginner.whyItMatters: The bonus shrinks as you level, so the helmet is enormous early and eventually becomes a penalty, which makes it a levelling item with a built-in expiry.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level five while the attribute bonus still outweighs the per-level cost. Work out where the two cross for your roll and replace it there.

flavourText:
Drink deeply of the Well.
Let the Abyss coil within.
description: (30-20)% reduced Presence Area of Effect (30-20)% reduced Light Radius (Can gain 0-4 custom Desecrated Modifiers) (Hidden)

beginner.whatItIs: An abyssal signet that inflicts Abyssal Wasting on hit, shrinks your presence and light radius, and can carry up to four desecrated modifiers from a very large pool.
beginner.whyItMatters: The desecrated modifiers are where nearly all of its power sits, so the base ring is a shell and the roll is the item.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level forty once it carries desecrated modifiers your build wants. Undesecrated it is mostly penalties.

name: Grip of Winter
explicitStats: Adds (3-5) to (6-8) Cold damage to Attacks
(20-30)% increased Magnitude of Chill you inflict
flavourText:
After the eruption, the skies turned grey,
ash began to fall, and a chill set in...
description: (30-50)% increased Evasion Rating Adds (3-5) to (6-8) Cold damage to Attacks +(20-30)% to Cold Resistance (40-50)% increased Freeze Buildup (20-30)% increased Magnitude of Chill you inflict

beginner.whatItIs: Firm bracers with evasion, cold resistance and added cold damage that build freeze faster and deepen the chill you apply.
beginner.whyItMatters: Freeze and chill are defence disguised as damage, since an enemy that is frozen or heavily chilled cannot attack you properly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level eleven on any cold build, and they stay useful well past their level because ailment buildup does not get outscaled the way flat damage does.

name: Guiding Palm
explicitStats: Allies in your Presence deal (15-23) to (28-35) added Attack Cold Damage
50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence
flavourText: The stories we tell serve to unite us.
description: Allies in your Presence deal (15-23) to (28-35) added Attack Cold Damage +(5-10) to all Attributes 25% increased Light Radius 50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence

variants.label: Fire

50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence

variants.label: Lightning
explicitStats: Allies in your Presence deal 1 to (56-70) added Attack Lightning Damage
50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence

beginner.whatItIs: A shrine sceptre with attributes and light radius that gives allies near you added cold damage on their attacks and shares half of your base life regeneration with them.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a pure support weapon: both of its lines do nothing for you and everything for the people standing next to you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For group play at level sixty-five on a support character with high life regeneration to share.

name: Guiding Palm of the Eye
explicitStats: Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Cold Damage
Allies in your Presence deal (15-23) to (28-35) added Attack Cold Damage
50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence
Grants effect of Guided Freezing Shrine
flavourText:
"With piercing eyes, you saw through the Stillness.
Undulating as one, you gloriously covered all in white.
But... I can bear you no longer."
The Dreamer whispered with fogging breath, ice creeping down his hand.
description: Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Cold Damage Allies in your Presence deal (15-23) to (28-35) added Attack Cold Damage 50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence +(20-30) to Intelligence 25% increased Light Radius Grants effect of Guided Freezing Shrine

beginner.whatItIs: A shrine sceptre variant that adds cold damage to your own hits as well as your allies', shares your life regeneration, and grants the effect of a Guided Freezing Shrine.
beginner.whyItMatters: Unlike the plain version it also arms the wielder, so a supporting character keeps a real damage contribution instead of only enabling other people.
beginner.whenToUseIt: At level sixty-five for a cold support build that still wants to deal damage. The shrine effect is what separates it from the base sceptre.

name: Guiding Palm of the Heart
explicitStats: Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage
Allies in your Presence deal (15-23) to (28-35) added Attack Fire Damage
50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence
Grants effect of Guided Meteoric Shrine
flavourText:
"When the Third Pact was written in stone, the Dreamer gave the alliance of men and
beasts knowledge. In return, they gave him a drop of blood; one from each of the
races of Wraeclast. In the centuries that followed, his Will began to subtly change."
- Book of the Benevolent Dreamer, Histories 220:5
description: Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage Allies in your Presence deal (15-23) to (28-35) added Attack Fire Damage 50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence +(20-30) to Strength 25% increased Light Radius Grants effect of Guided Meteoric Shrine

beginner.whatItIs: A shrine sceptre variant built around fire: added fire damage for you and for allies near you, shared life regeneration, extra strength, and the effect of a Guided Meteoric Shrine.
beginner.whyItMatters: Its extra strength and fire scaling suit a heavier, more durable supporting character than the other palms do.
beginner.whenToUseIt: At level sixty-five in a party running fire damage. The shrine effect is the reason to pick this one over its siblings.

name: Guiding Palm of the Mind
explicitStats: Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Lightning Damage
Allies in your Presence deal 1 to (56-70) added Attack Lightning Damage
50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence
Grants effect of Guided Tempest Shrine
flavourText:
"Deep in thought, you would tremble the very air before you.
Wreathed in light, you nurtured them all.
And yet... Your nature became you."
The Dreamer mused with aching heart, as remnants of forking tendrils burst forth.
description: Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Lightning Damage Allies in your Presence deal 1 to (56-70) added Attack Lightning Damage 50% of your Base Life Regeneration is granted to Allies in your Presence +(20-30) to Dexterity 25% increased Light Radius Grants effect of Guided Tempest Shrine

beginner.whatItIs: A shrine sceptre variant focused on lightning: added lightning damage for you and your allies, shared life regeneration, extra dexterity, and the effect of a Guided Tempest Shrine.
beginner.whyItMatters: Its added lightning roll on allies has a very wide range, which makes it swingy in a way the fire and cold versions are not.
beginner.whenToUseIt: At level sixty-five in a party built on lightning damage and shock.

name: Hand of Wisdom and Action
explicitStats: Adds 1 to 10 Lightning Damage to Attacks per 20 Intelligence
flavourText:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
description: +(15-25) to Dexterity +(15-25) to Intelligence 1% increased Attack Speed per 20 Dexterity Adds 1 to 10 Lightning Damage to Attacks per 20 Intelligence

beginner.whatItIs: Spiral wraps that add dexterity and intelligence, then convert dexterity into attack speed and intelligence into added lightning damage on your attacks.
beginner.whyItMatters: Two attributes that normally only unlock gear become your attack speed and your damage, so an attribute-stacking character is rewarded for something it was doing anyway.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a dexterity and intelligence stacking attack build from level thirty-three. With ordinary attribute totals both conversions stay small.

name: Hateforge
explicitStats: Gain a random Charge on reaching Maximum Rage, no more than once every (3-6) seconds
Lose all Rage on reaching Maximum Rage
flavourText: The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire developed a blood fever born of corruption.
description: (300-400)% increased Armour Gain a random Charge on reaching Maximum Rage, no more than once every (3-6) seconds Lose all Rage on reaching Maximum Rage +(-10-10) to Maximum Rage Gain (3-6) Rage on Hit

beginner.whatItIs: Moulded mitts with an enormous armour bonus that gain rage on hit, grant a random charge when you reach maximum rage, and then strip all your rage away.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts rage from a buff you hold into a cycle you spend, so the gloves suit a build that wants charges rather than one that wants a full rage bar.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level sixty melee build that benefits from random charges. On a build whose damage depends on staying at maximum rage the reset works against you.

name: Headhunter
explicitStats: When you kill a Rare monster, you gain its Modifiers for 60 seconds
flavourText:
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
description: +(40-60) to maximum Life +(20-40) to Strength +(20-40) to Dexterity When you kill a Rare monster, you gain its Modifiers for 60 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy belt with life, strength and dexterity whose famous line copies a rare monster's modifiers onto you for a minute whenever you kill one.
beginner.whyItMatters: The buffs stack up as you clear, so a character wearing it gets stronger the longer it stays in dense content rather than being at its best on the first pack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For fast mapping through areas thick with rare monsters. In a single boss fight there is nothing to kill, so it is just a life and attribute belt.
