flavourText:
In ghastly pits beneath the world,
Kulemak grows countless new bodies,
each more powerful than the last.
Not all of his abominations survive.
description: (60-80)% increased Desecrated Modifier magnitudes (Custom Desecrated prefix) (Lich's Desecrated prefix) (Lich's Desecrated suffix) (Lich's Desecrated prefix or suffix) (List of mods)

beginner.whatItIs: A ravenous staff that carries four desecrated modifiers drawn from a large pool and increases the magnitude of every desecrated modifier on it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Its whole power is in the rolled modifiers, amplified by the staff's own line, so two copies can support completely different casters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: At level seventy-eight, judged entirely on the four modifiers it rolled. Read them before planning anything around it.

name: The Unleashed
explicitStats: (15-25)% of Damage taken from Hits bypasses Energy Shield if Energy Shield is below half
Gain 1 Runic Binding on Hit with Spells, no more than once every 0.5 seconds
Lose all Runic Bindings when you Shapeshift to gain that much Unbound Potential
flavourText:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.
description: (150-250)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(10-20) to Strength and Intelligence (15-25)% of Damage taken from Hits bypasses Energy Shield if Energy Shield is below half Gain 1 Runic Binding on Hit with Spells, no more than once every 0.5 seconds Lose all Runic Bindings when you Shapeshift to gain that much Unbound Potential

beginner.whatItIs: Revered vestments with high armour, energy shield and maximum resistances that build Runic Bindings when you hit with spells and convert them into Unbound Potential when you shapeshift.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards a very specific loop, casting to charge and then shifting to spend, so the chest only pays out on a build that does both rather than one or the other.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level sixty-five shapeshifting caster. Anything that cannot shapeshift never spends the bindings and just carries the shield penalty.

name: The Vertex

randomModifierPool.placeholder: (Equipment/Skill Gems) have no Attribute Requirements
options: Equipment has no Attribute Requirements
Skill Gems have no Attribute Requirements

flavourText:
"A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
description: Has no Attribute Requirements (100-150)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield (20-30)% increased Critical Hit Chance +(13-17)% to Chaos Resistance (Equipment/Skill Gems) have no Attribute Requirements

beginner.whatItIs: A tribal mask with defences, critical chance and chaos resistance that removes the attribute requirements from either your equipment or your skill gems, depending on its roll.
beginner.whyItMatters: Attribute requirements are why builds spend passive points on stats they otherwise ignore, and removing them frees those points for damage or defence.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level thirty-three on a build blocked by requirements. Check which of the two versions you have, since they solve different problems.

name: The Vile Knight
explicitStats: Deal 4% increased Damage with Hits to Rare or Unique Enemies for each second they've ever been in your Presence, up to a maximum of 200%
flavourText: Familiarity breeds contempt.
description: (60-100)% increased Armour and Evasion +(75-125) to Accuracy Rating (10-15) Life Regeneration per second Deal 4% increased Damage with Hits to Rare or Unique Enemies for each second they've ever been in your Presence, up to a maximum of 200%

beginner.whatItIs: A shielded helm with armour, evasion, accuracy and life regeneration that raises your damage against a rare or unique enemy for every second it has ever spent near you, up to double.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards a long fight rather than a fast one, so your damage against a boss is at its lowest in the opening and at its highest by the end.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level thirty-three build fighting drawn-out boss encounters. It contributes almost nothing while clearing packs.

name: The Whispering Ice
explicitStats: +(5-7) to Level of all Cold Spell Skills
Inflict Elemental Exposure on Hit, lowering Total Elemental Resistances by (50-60)%
flavourText:
"From what beast you derived, we can only fathom.
Aye, you of living ice, rotting gill, and untold nightmare!
We Brinerot return ye to the sea."
- Weylam Roth
description: +(5-7) to Level of all Cold Spell Skills (20-10)% reduced Cast Speed (5-10)% increased Intelligence 2% increased Spell Damage per 10 Intelligence Inflict Elemental Exposure on Hit, lowering Total Elemental Resistances by (50-60)%

beginner.whatItIs: A permafrost staff that grants several levels to all cold spell skills, scales spell damage with your intelligence, and inflicts a very deep elemental exposure on hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: The exposure lowers all three of the enemy's elemental resistances at once, which raises the damage of every elemental attack in the fight, not only yours.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level seventy-five intelligence-stacking cold caster. The reduced cast speed makes it a poor fit for a rapid-fire spell.

name: The Wicked Quill
explicitStats: Spells have a 25% chance to inflict Withered for 4 seconds on Hit
flavourText:
With a flick of the finger, their fates are written,
the pages torn to a million pieces.
description: (60-100)% increased Spell Damage +(60-100) to maximum Mana +(7-13)% to Chaos Resistance Spells have a 25% chance to inflict Withered for 4 seconds on Hit

beginner.whatItIs: A level one withered wand with a large spell damage bonus, extra mana and chaos resistance whose spells have a chance to inflict Withered on hit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Withered raises the chaos damage the target takes and stacks up as you keep casting, so a chaos build's damage grows over the course of a fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on a chaos caster. On a build dealing no chaos damage the wither line adds nothing.

name: Thief's Torment
explicitStats: Gain 25 Life per Enemy Hit with Attacks
Gain 15 Mana per Enemy Hit with Attacks
50% reduced Duration of Curses on you
flavourText:
The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.
description: (30-40)% increased Rarity of Items found +(10-15)% to all Elemental Resistances Gain 25 Life per Enemy Hit with Attacks Can't use other Rings Gain 15 Mana per Enemy Hit with Attacks 50% reduced Duration of Curses on you

beginner.whatItIs: An emerald ring with heavy item rarity, elemental resistance and large life and mana gain on every enemy you hit, whose catch is that you cannot wear a second ring.
beginner.whyItMatters: Giving up an entire equipment slot is the price for recovery that scales with how many enemies you are hitting rather than with how many you kill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twenty-six on a fast attacking build in crowds. Compare it honestly against two ordinary rings before committing.

name: Threaded Light
flavourText:
A gift, a braid, of golden hair.
The war, forgotten.
The reason, remembered.
description: (50-70)% increased Energy Shield (30-40)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate 20% increased Light Radius (8-12)% increased Spell Damage per 10 Spirit

beginner.whatItIs: A woven focus with energy shield and mana regeneration that scales your spell damage with how much spirit you have.
beginner.whyItMatters: Spirit is normally spent on auras and minions rather than being a damage stat, so this turns an investment you made for other reasons into raw spell damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a high-spirit caster from level six. With little spirit the damage line contributes almost nothing.

name: Thrillsteel
flavourText:
We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
description: Onslaught

beginner.whatItIs: A spired greathelm whose only line grants Onslaught permanently.
beginner.whyItMatters: Onslaught raises attack, cast and movement speed at once, so a single simple helmet speeds up everything your character does with no condition attached.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twenty-seven on almost any build, and especially while levelling, where permanent speed is worth more than a small stat block.

name: Thunderfist
explicitStats: Adds 1 to (77-111) Lightning Damage to Unarmed Melee Hits
+(0.1-1.1)% to Unarmed Melee Attack Critical Hit Chance
flavourText:
The roar of the heavens
Strikes more than fear
Into the hearts of Man
description: (1-111)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield (1-11)% increased Attack Speed +(1-33)% to Lightning Resistance Adds 1 to (77-111) Lightning Damage to Unarmed Melee Hits +(0.1-1.1)% to Unarmed Melee Attack Critical Hit Chance

beginner.whatItIs: Utility wraps whose rolls swing from almost nothing to very high, adding large lightning damage and critical hit chance to unarmed melee hits.
beginner.whyItMatters: The roll ranges here are unusually wide, so two pairs can differ by a factor of a hundred and the item you found matters far more than the item's name.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For an unarmed build at level sixty-five, and only with a good roll. A poorly rolled pair is close to a blank glove slot.

name: Tidebreaker
explicitStats: +(2-3) to Level of all Melee Skills
All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Chill Magnitude
flavourText:
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.
description: (120-150)% increased Physical Damage +(2-3) to Level of all Melee Skills +(20-30) to Intelligence Causes (150-200)% increased Stun Buildup All Damage from Hits with this Weapon Contributes to Chill Magnitude

beginner.whatItIs: A pointed maul with high physical damage, intelligence and levels to all melee skills that greatly increases stun buildup and makes all of its damage build chill.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives a physical melee build both stun and chill from the same swings, so a weapon with no cold damage still slows everything it hits.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level forty-five on a physical melee build that wants crowd control alongside its damage.

name: Titanrot Cataphract
flavourText: Not the sound of thunder on the wind, but the Rhoaback Riders - Death charging from the sands.
description: (400-500)% increased Armour (15-30)% increased Strength 10% reduced Dexterity 10% reduced Intelligence You have no Life Regeneration

beginner.whatItIs: A maraketh cuirass with an enormous armour bonus and increased strength that removes your life regeneration entirely and shaves off some dexterity and intelligence.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing regeneration means every point of recovery has to come from flasks or leech, which is a whole missing system in exchange for armour numbers a level twenty character cannot otherwise reach.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a strength melee build from level twenty that already leeches. Do not wear it on a character whose recovery plan is regeneration.

name: Trampletoe
explicitStats: Deal 30% of Overkill damage to enemies within 2 metres of the enemy killed
flavourText: The truly mighty are never outnumbered.
description: 15% increased Movement Speed (50-100)% increased Armour 50% increased Attribute Requirements Deal 30% of Overkill damage to enemies within 2 metres of the enemy killed

beginner.whatItIs: Trimmed greaves with movement speed and armour, with steeper attribute requirements, that spill part of your overkill damage onto enemies standing near whatever you just killed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns an overkill hit from wasted damage into a chain reaction, which is why a slow, hard-hitting build clears packs faster while attacking no faster at all.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twenty-seven on a heavy-hitting melee build in dense content. It does nothing against a single boss.

name: Treefingers
explicitStats: Adds (6-10) to (12-16) Physical Damage to Attacks
flavourText:
The largest beings on Wraeclast
are not flesh and blood.
description: (30-60)% increased Armour Adds (6-10) to (12-16) Physical Damage to Attacks 5% reduced Attack Speed (20-30)% increased Stun Buildup Giant's Blood +(15-20) to Strength

beginner.whatItIs: Riveted mitts with armour, strength, added physical damage and stun buildup that grant Giant's Blood, at the cost of a little attack speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Giant's Blood lets you wield a two-handed weapon in one hand at triple the strength requirement, which is a whole change of weapon setup from a level eleven glove.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a strength build that wants a two-handed weapon plus a shield. If you cannot meet the tripled strength requirement, the keyword does nothing.

name: Trenchtimbre
explicitStats: +(1-2) to Level of all Minion Skills
Increases and Reductions to Minion Attack Speed also affect you
flavourText:
Ezomyte loyalty was not given to distant leaders.
It was earned by comrades in arms.
description: Adds (13-15) to (22-25) Physical Damage (20-30)% increased Attack Speed +(1-2) to Level of all Minion Skills Increases and Reductions to Minion Attack Speed also affect you

beginner.whatItIs: A spiked club with added physical damage and attack speed that grants levels to all minion skills and makes minion attack speed bonuses apply to you as well.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets a summoner's minion investment speed up its own attacks, so gear and passives bought for the army also make the player faster.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a minion build that also attacks in melee, from level sixteen. A summoner that never attacks gains only the skill levels.

name: Trephina
explicitStats: Always deals Critical Hits against Heavy Stunned Enemies
flavourText: The art of surgery advances one mistake at a time.
description: Adds (12-15) to (22-25) Physical Damage (10-15)% increased Attack Speed Causes (30-50)% increased Stun Buildup Always deals Critical Hits against Heavy Stunned Enemies

beginner.whatItIs: A forge maul that crushes enemies on hit, greatly increases stun buildup, and always critically hits anything that is heavily stunned.
beginner.whyItMatters: It builds the stun and then guarantees a critical hit on the stunned target, so the weapon sets up and cashes in its own combo.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level eleven on a melee build against enemies you can stun. Bosses with high stun thresholds are much harder to set up.

name: Twisted Empyrean
explicitStats: (10-20)% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life
Attacks with this Weapon have Added Cold Damage equal to (6-8)% to (10-12)% of maximum Mana
Convert 100% of Fire Damage with Mace Skills to Cold Damage
flavourText: Infinite mutations over endless eons borne upon it in a singular moment.
description: (80-100)% increased Physical Damage Adds (150-200) to (350-400) Cold Damage +(300-400) to maximum Mana +(4-6)% to Critical Hit Chance (10-20)% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life Attacks with this Weapon have Added Cold Damage equal to (6-8)% to (10-12)% of maximum Mana Convert 100% of Fire Damage with Mace Skills to Cold Damage

beginner.whatItIs: An aberrant sledge with high physical and cold damage, a very large mana bonus, added cold damage scaled off your maximum mana, and full conversion of mace fire damage to cold.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes mana a damage stat and a defensive one at the same time, since part of the damage you take is also paid from that pool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level seventy high-mana mace build. Its strength requirement is among the steepest on any two-handed mace.

name: Tyranny's Grip
flavourText:
The might of the Eternal Empire was formidable,
but rebels of every culture stood together as one.
description: (150-200)% increased Physical Damage (15-10)% reduced Attack Speed +(15-30) to Strength Strikes deal Splash Damage Knocks Back Enemies on Hit Cannot use Projectile Attacks

beginner.whatItIs: An ironhead spear with a very large physical damage bonus that makes your strikes splash and knock enemies back, at the cost of attack speed and the ability to use projectile attacks.
beginner.whyItMatters: A spear that cannot throw is a pure melee weapon, so it gives up half of what spears normally do in exchange for area damage and control.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level five on a melee spear build clearing packs. Any skill that throws the spear is unusable while it is equipped.

name: Uhtred's Chalice
explicitStats: Lose 5% Life per second while you have no Runic Ward during Effect
Mana Recovery from Flasks can Overflow maximum Mana during Effect
flavourText:
Uhtred drank. Verisium burned through his veins.
He gazed at death's face. With all his strength,
he turned instead to the stars, and witnessed Truth.
description: (200-300)% increased Amount Recovered 70% reduced Recovery rate (60-50)% reduced Charges Lose 5% Life per second while you have no Runic Ward during Effect Mana Recovery from Flasks can Overflow maximum Mana during Effect

beginner.whatItIs: A transcendent mana flask that restores far more mana at a much slower rate, lets mana recovery push past your maximum, and drains life while you have no runic ward.
beginner.whyItMatters: Overflowing your maximum mana is a buffer nothing else provides, and the life drain makes runic ward a requirement rather than a nice extra.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level fifty build with reliable runic ward and a use for excess mana. Without ward the drain starts the moment you drink.

name: Umbilicus Immortalis
explicitStats: Your Life Flask also applies to your Minions
Minions cannot Die while affected by a Life Flask
flavourText:
"The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3
description: (40-30)% reduced Flask Effect Duration +(20-30) to Intelligence Minions have (20-30)% increased maximum Life Your Life Flask also applies to your Minions Minions cannot Die while affected by a Life Flask (20-30)% increased Flask Charges gained

beginner.whatItIs: A linen belt with intelligence that gives your minions more life, applies your life flask to them as well, and stops them dying at all while that flask is active, at the cost of much shorter flask durations.
beginner.whyItMatters: Minions that cannot die during a flask turn the most fragile part of a summoner build into a window of guaranteed uptime, which is exactly what boss fights take away.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a minion build from level twenty-four, timed so the flask covers the dangerous phase of a fight rather than being drunk on cooldown.

name: Undying Hate
explicitStats: Glorifying the defilement of (79-30977) souls in tribute to (Amanamu-Ulaman-Kurgal-Tecrod-Kulemak)
Passives in radius are Conquered by the Abyssals
flavourText:
They believed themselves driven by necessity,
but that desperation made them monstrous.
description: Glorifying the defilement of (79-30977) souls in tribute to (Amanamu-Ulaman-Kurgal-Tecrod-Kulemak) Passives in radius are Conquered by the Abyssals Desecration makes this item Unstable Historic (Can gain 0-4 custom Desecrated Modifiers) (Hidden)

beginner.whatItIs: A timeless jewel that converts the passives in its radius into Abyssal passives, with the result seeded by a number, and can gain desecrated modifiers at the cost of becoming unstable.
beginner.whyItMatters: It changes what a whole region of your tree does, and the desecration option adds another layer of unpredictable modifiers on top.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a character willing to rebuild part of its tree around the conversion. Understand the instability before desecrating it.

name: Unforeseen Consequences
explicitStats: Map is overrun by the Abyssal
flavourText:
The Well was naught.
The Precursors dug too deep.
The Well always had been.
description: Map contains (14-18) additional Abysses Map is overrun by the Abyssal

beginner.whatItIs: An abyss tablet with one use that fills a map with well over a dozen extra abysses and leaves it overrun by the Abyssal.
beginner.whyItMatters: Abysses are the source of abyssal rewards, so concentrating that many into one map turns a normal run into a dedicated farming session.
beginner.whenToUseIt: On a map you can clear safely, since being overrun makes it considerably more dangerous than usual.

name: Ungil's Harmony
explicitStats: Your Critical Hits do not deal extra Damage
flavourText: Gentle anger, raging calm.
description: +(30-50) to maximum Life +(30-50) to maximum Mana (100-200)% increased Critical Hit Chance +(60-100) to Stun Threshold Your Critical Hits do not deal extra Damage

beginner.whatItIs: An azure amulet with life, mana, stun threshold and a very large critical hit chance bonus, whose catch is that your critical hits stop dealing extra damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It separates the two halves of critical strikes, so you keep every effect that triggers on a critical hit while giving up the damage spike they normally carry.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a build whose payoff is something that happens on a critical hit rather than the critical damage itself. On a build that scales critical damage it is a straight loss.

name: Valako's Roar
implicitStats: Used when you take Lightning damage from a Hit
explicitStats: Grants a Frenzy Charge on use
flavourText:
The sea swells, the sky thunders; two ships tilt at odds.
Flashes of light show only swinging axes... and a grin.
description: (30-40)% increased Charges gained Grants a Frenzy Charge on use

beginner.whatItIs: A topaz charm that triggers on lightning damage, grants a frenzy charge on use, and gains charges more quickly than normal.
beginner.whyItMatters: Frenzy charges are usually earned by killing, so getting one from being hit gives a build a second generator that works even when nothing is dying.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level five on a frenzy charge build in lightning content. Without a use for charges it is a plain lightning charm.

name: Valako's Vice
explicitStats: 100% of Fire damage Converted to Lightning damage
flavourText:
Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano,
Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.
description: (50-100)% increased Armour and Evasion (5-10)% increased Attack Speed +(20-30) to Strength +(20-30) to Dexterity +(30-50)% to Lightning Resistance 100% of Fire damage Converted to Lightning damage

beginner.whatItIs: Plate gauntlets with armour, evasion, attributes, attack speed and lightning resistance that convert all of your fire damage into lightning damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Full conversion lets a build scale two damage types at once, taking fire bonuses from gear and passives while dealing lightning to the enemy.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a lightning build at level forty-five that can also access fire damage bonuses. On a pure fire build the conversion works against your penetration.

name: Veil of the Night
flavourText:
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.
description: 50% increased maximum Life +(10-20) to all Attributes 40% reduced Light Radius You have no Elemental Resistances

beginner.whatItIs: A martyr crown that raises your maximum life by half and adds attributes, at the cost of removing your elemental resistances entirely.
beginner.whyItMatters: Losing all resistance multiplies every elemental hit you take, so half again as much life rarely covers it, and the helmet is far more dangerous than its life bonus looks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only for a build that has another way to handle elemental damage, such as heavy conversion or avoidance. For most characters at level twenty-eight it is a trap.

name: Veilpiercer
explicitStats: Curses you inflict can affect Hexproof Enemies
Curses you inflict spread to enemies within 3 metres when Cursed enemy dies
Gain 1 Dark Whisper every second there is a Cursed Enemy in your Presence
(20-40)% increased Damage with Hits against targets in your Presence
flavourText:
The tribe revelled wildly, unaware that each fruit
they ate further bound their continuity to the fog's.
In time, the merest touch could break their reality.
description: +(60-100) to maximum Mana +(15-25) to Intelligence Curses you inflict can affect Hexproof Enemies Curses you inflict spread to enemies within 3 metres when Cursed enemy dies Gain 1 Dark Whisper every second there is a Cursed Enemy in your Presence (20-40)% increased Damage with Hits against targets in your Presence

beginner.whatItIs: An amethyst ring with mana, intelligence and chaos resistance that lets your curses affect hexproof enemies, spreads curses when a cursed enemy dies, and builds Dark Whispers while a cursed enemy is near you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Hexproof enemies are normally immune to your curses entirely, so the ring opens up a whole category of target a curse build otherwise cannot touch.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twenty on a curse build going into content with hexproof monsters.

name: Venopuncture
implicitStats: Adds 1 to 4 Physical Damage to Attacks
explicitStats: Adds (5-7) to (9-13) Physical Damage to Attacks
All Damage taken from Hits while Bleeding Contributes to Magnitude of Chill on you
All Damage from Hits against Bleeding targets Contributes to Chill Magnitude
(10-20)% chance to inflict Bleeding on Hit
(15-25)% increased Magnitude of Bleeding you inflict
flavourText:
There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.
description: Adds (5-7) to (9-13) Physical Damage to Attacks +(20-30) to Strength All Damage taken from Hits while Bleeding Contributes to Magnitude of Chill on you All Damage from Hits against Bleeding targets Contributes to Chill Magnitude (10-20)% chance to inflict Bleeding on Hit (15-25)% increased Magnitude of Bleeding you inflict

beginner.whatItIs: An iron ring with added physical damage and strength that makes damage against bleeding enemies build chill, deepens the bleeds you inflict, and lets damage taken while you are bleeding chill you.
beginner.whyItMatters: It pairs a damage over time you apply with crowd control you get for free, while making an enemy bleed on you far more dangerous than usual.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a bleed build at level thirty-six with a way to stop bleeding on yourself. In content full of bleed the second half turns on you.

name: Ventor's Gamble
flavourText:
In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.
description: +(0-80) to maximum Life +(0-20) to Spirit (-25-25)% increased Rarity of Items found +(-40-40)% to Fire Resistance +(-40-40)% to Cold Resistance +(-40-40)% to Lightning Resistance

beginner.whatItIs: A gold ring where every line rolls across an enormous range, from nothing to eighty maximum life and from minus forty to plus forty on each elemental resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: Two copies can be a great ring and an actively harmful one, so the roll is the entire item and the name tells you nothing about its value.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixty-four, and only after reading every line. A badly rolled one can cost you more resistance than most gear provides.

name: Vestige of Darkness
explicitStats: Physical damage from Hits Contributes to Chill Magnitude and Freeze Buildup
Enemies in your Presence are Blinded
flavourText:
"Your covetous hands bring the Unlight
ever closer to consuming your realm."
description: (150-200)% increased Armour and Energy Shield +(20-30) to Strength and Intelligence Physical damage from Hits Contributes to Chill Magnitude and Freeze Buildup Enemies in your Presence are Blinded The Bodach haunts your Presence

beginner.whatItIs: A tenebrous crown with high defences and attributes that makes your physical hit damage build chill and freeze, blinds enemies near you, and summons the Bodach to haunt your presence.
beginner.whyItMatters: It hands a physical build the freezing tools a cold build normally has, so your existing damage starts locking enemies down without any conversion.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a physical build at level sixty-five that wants crowd control. A cold build already builds freeze and gains far less.

name: Vigilant View
explicitStats: Enemies have an Accuracy Penalty against you based on Distance
flavourText:
The warriors of the Unblinking Eye moved
together as one, shoulder to shoulder.
description: +(100-150) to Accuracy Rating +(100-150) to Evasion Rating (10-20)% increased Rarity of Items found +(20-30) to Dexterity Enemies have an Accuracy Penalty against you based on Distance Maximum Chance to Evade is 50%

beginner.whatItIs: An emerald ring with accuracy, evasion, dexterity and item rarity that gives enemies an accuracy penalty based on how far away you are, and caps your chance to evade at fifty percent.
beginner.whyItMatters: It trades away the top end of evasion for a defence that grows with distance, so fighting at range becomes a defensive decision rather than only a comfortable one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level twenty-six on a ranged build. A high-evasion character that already exceeds a fifty percent evade chance loses more than it gains.

name: Vis Mortis
flavourText:
Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved
description: (70-100)% increased Energy Shield +(70-100) to maximum Mana Minions have 50% reduced maximum Life Minions have Unholy Might

beginner.whatItIs: A plated raiment with energy shield and mana that halves your minions' maximum life and gives them Unholy Might.
beginner.whyItMatters: Unholy Might adds chaos damage to your minions' hits, so it trades their durability for a large flat damage gain across your whole army at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a summoner at level fifty-eight whose minions kill things before they get hit, such as ranged or short-lived ones. It is punishing on a build relying on tanky minions.

name: Visage of Ayah
flavourText:
Tale-women do not fight as dekharas.
They command a power all thier own.
description: (50-80)% increased Energy Shield (10-15)% increased Rarity of Items found (20-30)% increased Critical Hit Chance +(10-20)% to Lightning Resistance Eldritch Battery

beginner.whatItIs: A beaded circlet with energy shield, critical chance, item rarity and lightning resistance that grants Eldritch Battery.
beginner.whyItMatters: Eldritch Battery turns your energy shield into mana, which lets a caster spend its shield to cast and removes the mana problem entirely at the cost of that defensive layer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on a caster short of mana with shield to spare. It is a poor idea if your survival depends on that shield staying full.

name: Visions of Paradise
explicitStats: If Map was not previously Irradiated, completing Map adds Irradiation instead
flavourText: If they had ever completed the tower network, it could have changed the face of the world...
description: If Map was not previously Irradiated, completing Map adds Irradiation instead

beginner.whatItIs: An irradiated tablet with one use that adds irradiation to a map on completion, if the map was not already irradiated.
beginner.whyItMatters: It delays the effect rather than applying it up front, so the reward arrives after the run instead of changing the run itself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: On a map that is not already irradiated. Used on one that is, the tablet does nothing.

name: Voices

randomModifierPool.placeholder: Allocates (2-4) Sinister Jewel sockets
options: Allocates 2 Sinister Jewel sockets
Allocates 3 Sinister Jewel sockets
Allocates 4 Sinister Jewel sockets

flavourText: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.
description: Allocates (2-4) Sinister Jewel sockets

beginner.whatItIs: A sapphire jewel that allocates two to four Sinister jewel sockets on the passive tree.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns one socket into several, so the jewel is really a multiplier on the jewels you have waiting to be placed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only if you own jewels good enough to fill the new sockets. Empty sockets make it one of the weakest jewels you can equip.

name: Voll's Protector
explicitStats: 25% chance to gain a Power Charge on Critical Hit
flavourText:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
description: (150-200)% increased Armour and Energy Shield 25% reduced maximum Mana +(13-17)% to Chaos Resistance 25% chance to gain a Power Charge on Critical Hit

beginner.whatItIs: Plated vestments with armour, energy shield and chaos resistance that grant a power charge on a quarter of your critical hits, in exchange for a quarter of your maximum mana.
beginner.whyItMatters: It removes the usual need for a separate charge generator, freeing the passive points or gem slot a critical build normally spends just to keep charges up.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a critical hit build at level fifty-nine with mana to spare. On a mana-hungry caster the missing quarter is felt on every cast.

name: Voltaxic Rift
explicitStats: 100% of Lightning Damage Converted to Chaos Damage
Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Shock Chance
flavourText:
The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.
description: Adds 1 to (300-500) Lightning Damage (10-15)% increased Attack Speed 100% of Lightning Damage Converted to Chaos Damage Chaos Damage from Hits also Contributes to Shock Chance

beginner.whatItIs: A very high level fanatic bow with an enormous lightning damage roll that converts all of that lightning damage into chaos damage, and lets the chaos damage still build shock.
beginner.whyItMatters: Chaos damage is resisted by far fewer enemies than lightning, so the conversion keeps the shock payoff while dodging the resistance that would normally blunt it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level seventy-nine bow build that wants shock without fighting lightning resistance. Its dexterity requirement is among the steepest on any bow.

name: Waistgate
explicitStats: Life and Mana Flasks can be equipped in either slot
flavourText: Clever artifice is not alaways complex.
description: +(50-80) to maximum Life +(50-80) to maximum Mana (20-30)% increased Flask Life Recovery rate (20-30)% increased Flask Mana Recovery rate Life and Mana Flasks can be equipped in either slot

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy belt with life, mana and faster flask recovery that lets a life flask and a mana flask sit in either of the two flask slots.
beginner.whyItMatters: Freeing the slots means you can carry two of whichever flask your build actually needs instead of one of each, which is a real choice most characters never get.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For any build that leans hard on one resource, such as a caster carrying two mana flasks, from level fifty.

name: Wake of Destruction
explicitStats: Adds 1 to (30-50) Lightning damage to Attacks
Drop Shocked Ground while moving, lasting 8 seconds
flavourText:
Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.
description: 10% increased Movement Speed (30-60)% increased Armour and Energy Shield Adds 1 to (30-50) Lightning damage to Attacks Drop Shocked Ground while moving, lasting 8 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: Secured leggings with movement speed and defences that add lightning damage to your attacks and leave shocked ground behind you as you move.
beginner.whyItMatters: Shocked ground raises the damage everything standing on it takes, so simply walking through a fight is a damage buff for you and anyone with you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on a mobile build that kites, especially in a party. Standing still turns the trail off.

name: Wandering Reliquary
explicitStats: 50% of Physical Damage prevented Recouped as Life
flavourText:
Knowing she could outlast any opponent,
Wrashmin fought not to win, but to delay.
description: (50-100)% increased Armour +(40-60) to maximum Mana +(10-20) to Strength +(60-80) to Stun Threshold 50% of Physical Damage prevented Recouped as Life

beginner.whatItIs: A steel plate with armour, mana, strength and stun threshold that heals you for half of the physical damage your armour prevented.
beginner.whyItMatters: It pays you for the damage you already stopped, so heavy armour stops being purely defensive and starts functioning as a source of recovery in every fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a high-armour character from level twenty-seven taking frequent physical hits. Against elemental damage the recoup line does nothing.

name: Wanderlust
explicitStats: Your speed is unaffected by Slows
flavourText: All the world is my home.
description: 20% increased Movement Speed +(10-20) to maximum Energy Shield +5 to Dexterity Your speed is unaffected by Slows

beginner.whatItIs: Wrapped sandals with a large movement speed bonus, a little energy shield and dexterity, whose special line makes slows unable to affect your speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slows are the most common way an early character is caught out of position, and removing them entirely for one slot is enormous value at level eleven.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wear them through the campaign on any character. They are among the first uniques worth keeping in your bag until something better appears.

name: Waveshaper
explicitStats: Increases and Reductions to Mana Regeneration Rate also apply to Energy Shield Recharge Rate
Gain (30-50)% of Maximum Mana as Armour
flavourText:
"Move in ways your enemy does not expect.
Confuse them with elegance and grace.
They'll never see the axe coming."
- Rakiata, Chieftain of the Tasalio Tribe
description: +(100-200) to maximum Energy Shield +(20-40) to Spirit +(25-35)% to Fire Resistance +(25-35)% to Cold Resistance Increases and Reductions to Mana Regeneration Rate also apply to Energy Shield Recharge Rate Gain (30-50)% of Maximum Mana as Armour

beginner.whatItIs: A tideseer mantle with energy shield, spirit and elemental resistance that turns a large slice of your maximum mana into armour and makes mana regeneration bonuses apply to energy shield recharge as well.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes a caster's mana investment pay for two defences it never touches normally, so stacking mana becomes a defensive plan rather than only a casting one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a high-mana caster at level fifty-one. With a small mana pool neither of the two conversion lines amounts to much.

name: Whisper of the Brotherhood
explicitStats: 100% of Cold Damage Converted to Lightning Damage
flavourText:
Forged by the last remaining brother
to return all that was once given.
description: (5-10)% increased Skill Speed +(10-20) to Dexterity (25-35)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate 100% of Cold Damage Converted to Lightning Damage

beginner.whatItIs: A sapphire ring with cold resistance, dexterity, skill speed and mana regeneration that converts all of your cold damage into lightning damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Full conversion lets a build take cold bonuses from its passives and gear while dealing lightning to the enemy, which is how a build scales two elements at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level thirty-two on a lightning build with access to cold scaling. A build built around freezing loses its ailment entirely.

name: Widow's Reign
explicitStats: Life that would be lost by taking Damage is instead Reserved until you take no Damage to Life for 3 seconds
flavourText:
That day, both the Unblinking Eye and
their enemies stood in silence. That day,
the sky was clear, but it was raining.
description: (100-150)% increased Armour and Evasion +(100-150) to maximum Life +(17-23)% to Chaos Resistance +(200-300) to Ailment Threshold Life that would be lost by taking Damage is instead Reserved until you take no Damage to Life for 3 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A knight armour with life, chaos resistance and a large ailment threshold that reserves the life you would have lost instead of removing it, giving it back once you avoid damage for three seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Damage becomes reversible: a fight you escape costs you nothing permanently, which changes retreating from an admission of failure into a real recovery tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a level forty-five character that can break away from a fight. Under unbroken pressure the reservation never releases and your usable life keeps shrinking.

name: Widowhail
explicitStats: (150-250)% increased bonuses gained from Equipped Quiver
flavourText:
"A volley of arrows were loosed
from my bow into the heart of
the man who slew my beloved.
I felt nothing but cold fury."
- Chieftain Enoroa
description: (150-250)% increased bonuses gained from Equipped Quiver

beginner.whatItIs: A crude bow with almost no damage of its own whose single line multiplies every bonus your equipped quiver gives you.
beginner.whyItMatters: It moves your damage out of the weapon slot and into the quiver, so the bow is close to worthless on its own and becomes strong the instant you pair it with a powerful quiver.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only equip it once you own a quiver worth multiplying. With an ordinary quiver you are fighting with a level one bow.

name: Window to Paradise
explicitStats: Inflict Elemental Exposure to Enemies 3 metres in front of you for 4 seconds, every 0.25 seconds while raised
flavourText:
"Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare,
the Savior will build utopia."
description: (60-120)% increased Armour +(60-100) to maximum Mana +(10-15)% to all Elemental Resistances Inflict Elemental Exposure to Enemies 3 metres in front of you for 4 seconds, every 0.25 seconds while raised

beginner.whatItIs: A barricade tower shield with armour, mana and elemental resistance that applies elemental exposure to enemies in front of you four times a second while raised.
beginner.whyItMatters: Exposure lowers the enemy's resistance to an element, so holding your shield up becomes a damage buff for you and everyone fighting with you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level sixteen on an elemental build that raises its shield, and it is worth more in a party than alone.

name: Windscream
explicitStats: Curse Skills have (10-20)% increased Cast Speed
flavourText:
The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell
description: (10-20)% increased Movement Speed (50-100)% increased Energy Shield +(10-20) to Intelligence Curse Skills have (10-20)% increased Cast Speed Curses have no Activation Delay

beginner.whatItIs: Feathered sandals with movement speed, energy shield and intelligence that speed up curse casting and remove the activation delay curses normally have.
beginner.whyItMatters: The delay is why a curse often lands after the fight has already moved on, so removing it makes cursing a usable opener rather than an afterthought.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a curse-focused character from level thirty-three. On a build with no curses the boots are ordinary caster footwear.

name: Wings of Caelyn
explicitStats: Every Rage also grants 1% increased Stun Threshold
flavourText: The older brother rtetained calm in the midst of fury.
description: +20 to Armour (5-15)% increased Rarity of Items found +(20-30) to Dexterity Gain 1 Rage on Melee Hit Every Rage also grants 1% increased Stun Threshold

beginner.whatItIs: A rusted greathelm at level one with dexterity, armour and item rarity that gains rage from melee hits and converts each point of rage into stun threshold.
beginner.whyItMatters: A rising stun threshold means the longer you fight, the harder you are to interrupt, which is exactly the problem a starting melee character has.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one on a melee build through the early acts, where being stunned is a more common death than raw damage.

name: Winter's Bite
explicitStats: Freezes Enemies that are on Full Life
flavourText: Nothing stabs colder than pure hatred.
description: No Physical Damage Adds (8-10) to (15-18) Cold Damage Freezes Enemies that are on Full Life

beginner.whatItIs: A level one glass shank with no physical damage at all, a chunk of added cold damage, and a line that freezes any enemy still at full life.
beginner.whyItMatters: Freezing on the opening hit means most enemies never get to act, which is an enormous defensive advantage in the first acts where your character is fragile.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level one for levelling a cold or critical character. It falls off as monsters gain the life and resistance to survive the first hit.

name: Wondertrap
explicitStats: 50% increased Rarity of Items found when on Low Life
flavourText: Wonders abound at death's door.
description: (10-20)% increased Movement Speed +(30-50) to maximum Energy Shield +(10-20) to Strength +(10-20) to Dexterity +(10-20) to Intelligence 50% increased Rarity of Items found when on Low Life

beginner.whatItIs: Silk slippers with movement speed, energy shield and all three attributes that greatly increase item rarity while your life is low.
beginner.whyItMatters: The rarity only applies while you are in danger, so the boots ask you to farm at a life total that is itself a risk to your run.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For farming content you can clear safely at low life from level twenty-seven, ideally on a build whose defence is energy shield rather than life.

name: Wraeclast Besieged
implicitStats: Adds an Otherworldy Breach to a Map
explicitStats: Unstable Breaches in Map take 120 additional seconds to collapse after timer is filled
Breaches in Map have (-20-10)% increased Monster density
flavourText:
In his broken madness, Xesht spills forth the hordes,
reaching out to wreak pain and ruination.
description: Unstable Breaches in Map take 120 additional seconds to collapse after timer is filled Breaches in Map have (-20-10)% increased Monster density

beginner.whatItIs: A breach tablet with five uses that gives unstable breaches a full two extra minutes before they collapse, with a monster density roll that can go either way.
beginner.whyItMatters: Breach rewards scale with how long you can keep one open, so two more minutes is a large increase in what a single breach can produce.
beginner.whenToUseIt: On a character fast enough to use the extra time. Check the density roll, since it can land negative.

name: Wulfsbane
explicitStats: Intimidate Enemies on Block for 8 seconds
flavourText:
The Counts of Ogham share a
legacy of cunning and power.
description: +(40-60) to maximum Life +(10-15) to Strength +(60-80) to Stun Threshold Intimidate Enemies on Block for 8 seconds

beginner.whatItIs: A painted tower shield with life, strength and stun threshold that intimidates enemies for several seconds whenever you block them.
beginner.whyItMatters: Intimidated enemies take more damage, so blocking sets up your next hit instead of only stopping theirs.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level six on an early blocking character. It is one of the more useful campaign shields for a melee build.

name: Xoph's Blood
explicitStats: Enemies in your Presence have -25% to Fire Resistance
flavourText:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.
description: (10-20)% increased maximum Life +(50-100)% to Fire Resistance Enemies in your Presence have -25% to Fire Resistance

beginner.whatItIs: An amber amulet with strength, extra maximum life and a large amount of fire resistance that also strips a quarter of the fire resistance off every enemy standing near you.
beginner.whyItMatters: Lowering enemy resistance multiplies the damage of everyone in the fight, not just yours, and it works without you having to cast or apply anything.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a fire build from level fifty-two, and it is worth even more in a party where several characters deal fire damage.

name: Yoke of Suffering
explicitStats: Enemies take (15-20)% increased Damage for each Elemental Ailment type among your Ailments on them
(40-30)% reduced Duration of Ignite, Shock and Chill on Enemies
flavourText: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.
description: +(10-15)% to all Elemental Resistances (15-30)% increased Elemental Damage Enemies take (15-20)% increased Damage for each Elemental Ailment type among your Ailments on them (40-30)% reduced Duration of Ignite, Shock and Chill on Enemies

beginner.whatItIs: A bloodstone amulet with life, elemental resistance and elemental damage that makes enemies take steadily more damage for each different elemental ailment you have on them, while shortening how long those ailments last.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards spreading ignite, shock and chill onto the same target rather than stacking one of them, which is a different way of building than most elemental characters use.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Take it on a build that can inflict at least two of the three ailments reliably. With only one ailment the bonus barely moves and you have paid for it with shorter durations.

name: Yriel's Fostering
explicitStats: (60-40)% reduced Duration of Bleeding on You
You can have two Companions of different types
flavourText:
Feed a beast and it will not hunt.
Protect it and it will not fight.
Ferocity must be learned, not taught.
It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
description: (100-150)% increased Evasion Rating +(80-120) to maximum Life +(10-30) to Spirit (60-40)% reduced Duration of Bleeding on You (60-40)% reduced Poison Duration on you You can have two Companions of different types

beginner.whatItIs: A strider vest with evasion, life and spirit that shortens bleeding and poison on you and lets you keep two companions of different types at once.
beginner.whyItMatters: A second companion adds a whole extra source of damage and distraction, which matters far more than the defensive numbers printed on the vest.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a companion build at level fifty-two. Without companions it is an ordinary evasion and life chest with two ailment lines.

name: Zaida's Longevity
explicitStats: You can only Socket Emerald Jewels in this item
+(5-10)% to Fire and Lightning Resistances per Equipped Item with a Cold Resistance Modifier
flavourText:
Though the rains refuse to return to a dry
Vastiri, we shall remain, unchanged.
description: Has 1 Jewel Socket (Hidden) You can only Socket Emerald Jewels in this item (10-20)% increased Rarity of Items found +(10-20) to all Attributes +(5-10)% to Fire and Lightning Resistances per Equipped Item with a Cold Resistance Modifier

beginner.whatItIs: A ring with a hidden jewel socket that only accepts emerald jewels, plus attributes, item rarity and fire and lightning resistance for each item you wear carrying a cold resistance modifier.
beginner.whyItMatters: It converts the resistance rolls already on your other gear into more resistance, so a coherent gear set is what makes it strong.
beginner.whenToUseIt: From level forty when several items already carry cold resistance and you have an emerald jewel worth the socket.

name: Zerphi's Genesis
explicitStats: 50% of Charges consumed by used Charms are granted to your Life Flasks
50% of Charges consumed by used Life Flasks are granted to your Charms
Skills from Corrupted Gems have (15-25)% increased Cost Efficiency during any Flask Effect
Corrupted Blood cannot be inflicted on you
flavourText: The most horrifying ideas often begin with a simple innovation.
description: (25-50)% increased Corrupted Charms effect duration 50% of Charges consumed by used Charms are granted to your Life Flasks 50% of Charges consumed by used Life Flasks are granted to your Charms +(10-30) to Strength Skills from Corrupted Gems have (15-25)% increased Cost Efficiency during any Flask Effect Corrupted Blood cannot be inflicted on you

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy belt built around corrupted gear: charms and life flasks feed charges to each other, corrupted charms last longer, corrupted gem skills cost less during a flask effect, and corrupted blood cannot be inflicted on you.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns corruption from a gamble you accept into something your build is paid for, and the shared charges mean using one recovery item refills the other.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For a character deliberately running corrupted gems and charms from level fifty-six. On uncorrupted gear most of the belt does nothing.

name: Zerphi's Serape
flavourText:
Mortality is a curse.
The cure is simple.
description: (60-80)% increased Evasion and Energy Shield +(40-60) to maximum Mana 50% increased Attribute Requirements (-30-30)% increased Life Regeneration rate (-30-30)% increased Mana Regeneration Rate Soul Eater

beginner.whatItIs: A scalper's jacket with evasion, energy shield and mana that grants Soul Eater, along with life and mana regeneration rolls that can land either positive or negative.
beginner.whyItMatters: Soul Eater stacks a growing buff as things die around you, so the jacket rewards clearing quickly through crowds rather than fighting one target at a time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: For fast clearing at level thirty-nine, and check both regeneration rolls first, since a doubly negative pair is a real defensive loss.
